SP_01.titleEn: BenGo - Build a Transportation Service System Connecting Drivers to Users using ReactJS, NodeJS, React Native and MongoDB
SP_01.description: BenGo is an on-demand transportation platform that acts as a reliable bridge between pickup-truck owners and individuals or businesses that need to move bulky goods. The Vietnamese market for large-item delivery is currently fragmented and relies heavily on informal arrangements, so customers struggle to find a suitable vehicle quickly and at a fair price, while drivers leave a large part of their working schedule idle. The system provides an efficient delivery marketplace that leverages a network of available vehicles: through the application a customer can describe a shipment, find a nearby transport partner and secure an optimal solution in a few simple steps, while drivers can fill empty slots in their schedule and generate additional income from delivery opportunities that match their vehicle and location.
SP_01.objective: The project aims to build a highly available platform covering mobile applications, backend services and databases that guarantees continuous user access, and to protect both users and drivers through end-to-end encryption, compliance with data-privacy regulations and regular security audits. A central objective is to develop and continuously optimise a matching algorithm that takes driver location, vehicle capacity, destination, traffic conditions and user ratings into account in real time so that orders are accepted quickly and routes remain efficient. The system also leverages historical order data to predict demand spikes by area and time so drivers can be guided proactively to high-demand zones, integrates precise real-time GPS tracking with an anonymised in-app communication channel, provides a seamless and secure online payment gateway together with clear dispute-resolution procedures and cargo insurance, and enforces a two-way rating system with background checks on driver identity and vehicle information to keep the community trustworthy.
SP_01.scope: The system is delivered as a combined web and mobile solution serving four roles. Customers register and manage profiles, create shipping requests with pick-up and delivery locations, goods descriptions and photos, receive automatic quotes based on distance and goods type, review recommended drivers and estimated arrival times, track the driver in real time, chat or call during the trip, pay online, rate the driver and review trip history and invoices. Drivers register with driving licence and vehicle inspection documents for approval, switch between online and offline status, receive nearby requests, accept or reject trips, navigate to pick-up and delivery points, update trip status through the full lifecycle, upload delivery-proof photos and track earnings and revenue statistics. Dispatchers monitor all orders in real time, view active drivers and their GPS positions, assign trips manually when automatic matching fails, handle special shipments such as fragile, heavy or urgent goods and support both sides when problems occur. Administrators manage users, browse driver documents, oversee orders and complaints, configure the price list including per-kilometre rates, surcharges and promotions, manage system content and generate reports on revenue, trip volume, cancellation rate and driver performance.
SP_01.technology: ReactJS, React Native, Node.js, MongoDB, WebSocket, Google Maps Platform, TLS/SSL
SP_01.expectedResult: The project delivers a complete platform consisting of a customer application, a driver application and a management system that together allow quick booking, tracking, transportation and payment. The research output covers an analysis of transportation operations, the technical design of the solution, a driver-suggestion mechanism, real-time GPS positioning, automatic pricing and a transparent delivery and payment process. The finished system is expected to operate stably, suggest accurate drivers, calculate transparent prices, reduce connection time between supply and demand and improve the overall user experience, while remaining reliable, safe, scalable and user friendly. The product can be deployed for real-life testing and expanded to commercial scale in the future.

SP_02.titleEn: CCNet - Building a Website to Manage Rescues and Volunteering Work using ReactJS, NodeJS and MongoDB
SP_02.description: Charitable and volunteer activities in Vietnam have grown rapidly in recent years, particularly during natural disasters, pandemics and other social hardships that increase the need for community support. This expansion has exposed serious problems: campaign information and results are published without transparency, which fuels public scepticism and erodes trust; activities are scattered across different platforms, which makes it hard to coordinate resources, track volunteer participation and manage campaign logistics; and people who need help have no centralised, reliable channel through which to submit verified requests, so information is often inaccurate or duplicated. The absence of a standardised identity-verification process and content-moderation mechanism further increases the risk of fraud, impersonation and misuse of charitable efforts for personal gain, while organisations struggle to consolidate data and evaluate campaign performance. CCNet responds with a technological solution that connects, standardises and brings transparency to charitable operations.
SP_02.objective: The project sets out to build a single platform that unifies fragmented charitable activity and restores public trust through transparency. It aims to provide verified identity checks and KYC workflows for organisers, a moderated channel through which people in need can submit help requests, and a full audit trail of donations so that donors can follow the financial goal, view financial statements, receipts and money flow for every campaign. Further objectives are to support the complete campaign lifecycle from project creation and approval through fundraising, volunteer recruitment, execution and reporting; to enable volunteer management with applications, approvals, check-in and check-out and automatic certificates; to give managers the tools to approve, decline or pause projects and to handle refund requests; and to consolidate campaign data so that organisations can evaluate performance and apply the insights to future activities.
SP_02.scope: The system is a web application built around a layered role model. Administrators manage users and roles, view system dashboards and export reports, suspend or ban accounts with documented reasons and create targeted system notifications. Managers act as verification and approval officers who review projects, approve, decline or pause them, handle refund requests, verify organiser registrations against KYC documents and AI risk scores, and match people-in-need requests with suitable organisers. Guests browse public projects and register. Base users verify their accounts via OTP, manage profiles, participate in a community forum with posts, comments and reactions, discover and follow projects and organisers, follow the financial goal of a campaign, report suspicious content, chat one-to-one or in project groups and search for users and organisers. Verified organisers create and update projects, submit them for approval, track funding progress, upload receipts and categorise expenses, post volunteer opportunities, review and approve applications and rely on automation for certificates, notifications and project group chats. Volunteers apply to projects and check in and out to log hours, donors donate with public or anonymous privacy settings, request refunds and view donation impact, and people in need submit help requests with supporting evidence.
SP_02.technology: ReactJS, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT, OAuth2, PayOS
SP_02.expectedResult: The expected output is a fully functional transparency-oriented charity platform covering the entire campaign lifecycle for eight distinct roles. It delivers verified organiser onboarding, moderated project publication, an end-to-end donation flow with a payment gateway and refund handling, public financial statements, volunteer recruitment with automated certificates and group chats, a community forum and a reporting and moderation toolset. Non-functional targets include a fully responsive interface with toast notifications, WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility, at least 99.5% uptime with MongoDB replica sets, responses within one second under normal load and support for at least 500 concurrent users, together with protection against injection, XSS and CSRF attacks, TLS 1.2+ and AES-256 encryption, multi-factor authentication, bcrypt password hashing, role-based access control and full logging of all financial and sensitive actions.

SP_03.titleEn: GearXpert - An Online Smart Platform for Personal Electronics Rental, Automated Maintenance and Intelligent Management using ReactJS, NodeJS and MongoDB
SP_03.description: In the digital era, personal electronics such as cameras, drones, laptops and gaming devices are in high demand for short-term rental, but users repeatedly face the same difficulties: finding a suitable device, tracking rental status, managing maintenance and handling payments efficiently. GearXpert is an online platform that combines a device-rental marketplace with automated maintenance management, providing a single unified solution for customers, suppliers, technicians, delivery staff and administrators. Customers search for and rent devices, track schedules, report issues, pay and give feedback; suppliers list and manage devices, track inventory, approve requests and coordinate maintenance; technicians handle inspection and repair; delivery staff move devices between parties; and administrators oversee the whole platform. An AI module supports the experience by recommending devices, reminding users of maintenance schedules and answering questions through a chat box.
SP_03.objective: The project aims to develop a web-based platform that connects customers with suppliers of electronic devices and to provide an automated maintenance-management system with scheduling and alerts so devices remain in reliable condition throughout their rental life. It also aims to implement secure online payment together with insurance integration for rentals, to design an administrative dashboard capable of managing users, suppliers, devices, transactions and reports, and to deliver a modern responsive interface built with ReactJS that raises the overall quality of the user experience.
SP_03.scope: The platform covers seven functional areas across five actor groups. User management handles registration and verification, login by email and password or Google OAuth, password reset and profile editing. Device search and rental lets users search by type, brand, features or availability, filter by price, condition, rating or supplier, book devices online and lets suppliers approve or decline requests and view schedules. Online payment and insurance covers secure payment, integration with insurance providers, transaction history, automatic cancellation of unpaid rentals and refunds for declined bookings. Device maintenance covers automated AI reminders, technician records of inspections, repairs and cost updates and supplier monitoring of device condition. Feedback and ratings allow customers to rate devices and suppliers and let administrators handle inappropriate reviews. Communication and support provides real-time chat between customers and suppliers or technicians plus issue reporting and dispute resolution. The admin dashboard covers system metrics, reports, management of users, suppliers, devices, rental contracts and transactions, and approval of withdrawal requests.
SP_03.technology: ReactJS, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, JWT, Cloudinary, Git/GitHub
SP_03.expectedResult: The project is expected to deliver a fully functional web-based application deployed online, supporting registration and rental for customers, device and inventory management for suppliers, maintenance workflows for technicians, delivery tracking for delivery staff and comprehensive oversight for administrators, together with automated functions where AI recommends devices, reminds users of maintenance schedules, cancels unpaid rentals and processes refunds. Accompanying deliverables include full documentation covering system design, architecture diagrams, user manuals and use-case diagrams, and source code stored and managed under version control on GitHub.

SP_04.titleEn: SMAS - Building a Restaurant Management Website System using React, ASP.NET and SQL Server
SP_04.description: SMAS is a modern restaurant management system built to optimise the service process, order management, table reservations, delivery and material control, helping restaurants operate faster, more accurately and more transparently while improving the customer experience. The system supports multiple user roles that reflect the operating model of a modern restaurant: customers book tables online, order food and track order status in real time; waiters welcome guests, open orders, record dishes and update table status; the kitchen and bar receive dishes through the system, prepare them and update completion status; cashiers and receptionists confirm reservations, process payments and control delivery orders; and the restaurant manager or owner supervises everything, adjusting the menu, controlling raw-material inventory, tracking revenue and keeping the whole operation smooth. Beyond these basics the platform integrates smart F&B inventory management, forecasting of raw materials running out through data analysis, warnings about spoiled or expired ingredients, automatic shipping-fee calculation by radius and a real-time operations dashboard.
SP_04.objective: SMAS aims to build a modern restaurant management platform that optimises the entire operating process from table reservation and on-site service through food preparation and payment to home delivery. The system is designed to minimise ordering errors, shorten service time and improve the customer experience through digitalised, synchronised real-time processes. It further aims to help restaurants control raw-material inventory more effectively by tracking imports, exports and stock levels, warning when materials run low or approach expiry so that loss is reduced and processing quality is assured, and to provide intuitive dashboards that let managers track revenue, employee performance and daily operations so they can make timely and accurate decisions.
SP_04.scope: The scope covers fourteen functional modules within a single responsive web application. Authentication provides registration, login, role permissions, password change and recovery plus Google login and OTP. User-profile management covers information viewing and updating, authorisation, account locking and work-shift management. Table and reservation management supports online booking by date and time, SMS or email confirmation, table-status management and automatic reminders as guest arrival approaches. Order management covers ordering at the table, dish status updates, splitting and merging tables and moving tables with notes, while online order management receives delivery orders with address and time, calculates shipping fees automatically by radius and coordinates internal shippers. Further modules cover menu and dish management, inventory and ingredient management with import, export and stock counts plus expiry monitoring, AI-powered inventory prediction of shortages and optimal stock levels, a kitchen display system with real-time synchronisation and waiting-time prioritisation, billing and payment with QR and e-wallet integration, discounts, vouchers and combos and electronic invoices, a notification and alert system, reporting and analytics, customer management with automatic offers for regulars, and external integrations.
SP_04.technology: .NET (ASP.NET), React, SQL Server, GitHub, GitHub Actions
SP_04.expectedResult: The expected result is a responsive web application built with ReactJS on the front end and .NET on the back end, integrated with essential external services such as payment gateways, cloud storage and Excel import and export. It delivers a complete set of core restaurant operations covering order management, table management, inventory tracking, staff roles, customer interactions and financial reporting, with role-based access control that keeps workflows secure and structured across all user groups. On top of these fundamentals the system provides advanced enhancements including AI-powered menu recommendations that predict favourite dishes for favourite times, predictive analytics, automated low-inventory alerts and intelligent handling of customer feedback through sentiment analysis.

SP_05.titleEn: FCMS - FPT University Project Management System using ReactJS, ASP.NET Core Web API, SQL Server and Firebase
SP_05.description: At FPT University, student projects - especially long-term team-based work such as Capstone projects, research projects and course projects - run over several months and are expected to follow structured development methodologies such as Scrum and Agile. In practice students, supervisors and academic administrators face significant difficulties because workflow management is fragmented. Teams rely on a mixture of Zalo or Messenger for communication, Excel or Trello for task tracking and Google Drive for documentation, which causes data inconsistency, loss of traceability and inefficient collaboration. Supervisors cannot monitor real-time progress, sprint execution or individual contributions across multiple teams, which makes fair and objective assessment difficult. Manual preparation of weekly reports, sprint summaries and progress evaluations consumes time that should be spent on learning, and existing tools were never designed to manage hundreds of concurrent student projects across courses, semesters and faculties.
SP_05.objective: The project sets out to design and build a centralised, all-in-one, web-based system for managing all student projects at FPT University, with Capstone projects as the primary but not exclusive use case. It aims to centralise project management across courses, semesters and faculties so teams no longer depend on fragmented third-party tools; to digitise and standardise academic Scrum practices including semester and project lifecycle management, sprint planning, backlogs, reviews and retrospectives and role-based participation for students, team leaders and supervisors; to reduce administrative burden through AI-assisted generation of weekly reports and sprint summaries, summarisation of meeting minutes and activity logs and assistance for supervisors in reviewing progress and identifying risks; to enhance transparency and fair assessment through real-time dashboards showing team velocity, individual contributions and project health; and to ensure security, scalability and usability by integrating with FPT authentication and supporting large numbers of concurrent projects.
SP_05.scope: The system covers workspace and project management with configurable project lifecycles per workspace including semester timeline, project duration and a sprint structure aligned with FPT Capstone standards of up to ten sprints, each with start date, end date and sprint goal. Workspace managers and delegated co-managers create and manage activities with descriptions, priority, due dates, estimates and assignees, while members view their assignments and update progress. An activity board visualises task status across the four states To Do, In Progress, Verify and Done, with comments, attachments, a full activity log of status changes, edits and assignee updates, and GitHub integration. Additional scope covers scheduling and event management for meetings and milestones, AI-assisted support producing automated weekly report drafts and activity summaries, and a notification and communication system delivering system alerts, updates and reminders. The research scope includes investigating existing project management platforms, applying modern web technologies for scalability, integrating AI for workload distribution, scheduling recommendations, progress evaluation and risk alerts, designing a user-centred real-time collaborative interface and implementing authentication, authorisation and data governance.
SP_05.technology: ReactJS, ASP.NET Core Web API, SQL Server, Firebase, Docker, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure Web App
SP_05.expectedResult: The expected output is a fully functional web-based student project management system in which users create, assign, manage and track project activities within a centralised workspace. Core modules cover workspace and project lifecycle management with semester, project timeline and sprint-based activity tracking, activity and collaboration management with task boards, comments and logs, scheduling and event management, AI-assisted support producing automated weekly report drafts and activity summaries, and a notification and communication system. The system provides a responsive user-friendly interface compatible with major browsers and common screen sizes. The project also delivers comprehensive documentation covering system architecture, database and domain design, use-case realisation, business workflows in BPMN and the implementation process with its technical decisions, plus a deployment-ready demonstration system suitable for presentation, evaluation and testing in an academic environment.

SP_06.titleEn: KVIT - Building a System to Support Studying and Practising for Korean Certificate Exams for Vitamin Korean Language Center using React, Spring Boot and MySQL
SP_06.description: Vitamin Korean Language Center has been operating for many years but carries out all of its learning activities manually, without any supporting website. Learners have no online environment in which to practise, teachers have no digital tools for building question banks or marking written and spoken work, and the centre has no systematic way to manage classes, schedules or learner records. In this situation the Director of the centre asked for a website to support students' learning and exam preparation for Korean certificates. The project therefore builds a client-driven web system whose features are all defined by the requirements of the centre's director, covering the full path from public information about courses and the centre through practice testing, forum discussion and teacher marking to administration.
SP_06.objective: The project aims to build a website that enhances the studying and mock-exam practice of students at Vitamin Center, delivering all features according to the requirements provided by the centre's director. Concretely it seeks to provide information about the centre and its courses, to offer mock tests together with the tools teachers need to create them for every type of Korean certificate, to give registered learners a forum, to enforce role-based access across guests, learners, staff, teachers, education managers and administrators, to integrate an AI chatbot able to answer questions about courses and certificates, to provide OCR that converts handwritten registration forms into digital records when electricity is unavailable, to give teachers an essay marking tool, and to provide an administrative dashboard with a moderation panel.
SP_06.scope: The system is a website serving six roles. Guests can register online and take a limited number of reading and listening mock tests. Learners take unlimited reading and listening mock tests, use the forum and submit essays and spoken recordings for writing and speaking assessment. Education managers approve the question bank, assign teachers, approve classes and approve requests to change class schedules. Administrators manage users, roles and permissions and control global settings and configuration. Staff enter learner information, authorise learners, receive reports from teachers and create classes with their type and schedule. Teachers create questions and mock tests, mark writing and speaking submissions, create and send reports about learners and request class-schedule changes. Shared features include notifications for important events. Non-functional scope requires responsive design with toast notifications and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, a maximum response time under one second with support for 500 concurrent users, and 99.5% uptime with fallback and recovery strategies.
SP_06.technology: React, Spring Boot, MySQL, Git, GitHub Actions, OpenAI GPT-4 API, OCR
SP_06.expectedResult: Because the requirements have been provided by the client, the research concentrates on optimising the tasks of the website, integrating AI into the product and deploying the system. The expected output is a fully functional website providing information about courses and the centre, mock tests together with the tools to create them for all types of Korean certificate, a forum for registered learners, a role-based access system, an AI chatbot that supports learners with course and certificate information, an OCR feature that transforms handwritten registration forms into digital records in case of a power outage, an essay marking tool for teachers and an admin dashboard with a moderation panel.

SP_07.titleEn: TikoSmart - Developing a Frozen Food Warehouse Management System for TIKOVIA Trading and Service Co., Ltd. using ReactJS, React Native and NodeJS
SP_07.description: Against the background of Vietnam's digital transformation, frozen-food distribution enterprises face significant challenges in warehouse management, order tracking and delivery coordination. Manual data entry and fragmented systems regularly lead to inventory discrepancies, delays and inefficient communication between departments. TikoSmart is developed for TIKOVIA Trading and Service Co., Ltd., a frozen-food distribution company, to digitalise and centralise its operational processes. The system integrates AI technologies that assist staff with data entry and verification, detect input errors, analyse employee performance and optimise delivery routes, helping Tikovia improve both efficiency and accuracy across warehouse and logistics management while keeping data consistent between the sales, warehouse, delivery and accounting departments.
SP_07.objective: The project aims to build a web and mobile management system covering warehouse, order, delivery and employee coordination for a frozen-food distributor. It applies AI assistance for error checking, smart order suggestions and voice input so that staff can work faster and with fewer mistakes, provides real-time inventory and delivery tracking that keeps data consistent across departments, and visualises business insights through interactive dashboards and KPI reports that support managerial decisions. Supporting objectives include analysing the operational workflows of Tikovia's warehouse and sales departments to identify pain points such as manual entry, tracking delays and unstandardised reporting, defining functional and non-functional requirements for the warehouse, sales, delivery and accounting modules, and designing a database schema that ensures consistency, scalability and accurate lot tracking for frozen goods.
SP_07.scope: The system spans seven functional areas across web and mobile clients. User and role management provides multi-role login for administrators, managers, sales, packing and delivery supervisors, sellers, packing staff, delivery staff and accountants, with employee account management and role-based access control. Product and inventory management covers product information including SKU, category, packaging and expiration, inventory lot tracking with quantity, expiry date and department linkage, stock-movement recording for purchases, sales and returns, and low-stock or near-expiry alerts. Order and sales management covers order creation and editing, status tracking with automatic timestamps and logs, customer records with order history and receivables, and invoice management. Preparation and delivery management covers packing task assignment, photographic evidence upload, supervisor review, grouping of orders into delivery runs with driver assignment, shipper status updates with proof of delivery and COD remittance verification. Supplier and purchase management, accounting and financial tracking, and reporting with role-specific dashboards and CSV or PDF export complete the operational scope, while AI-driven smart features add order grouping and route optimisation, voice input and natural-language paste-to-order intake.
SP_07.technology: ReactJS, React Native, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare, Docker, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Vercel
SP_07.expectedResult: The expected output is a fully functional web and mobile application with integrated AI assistance, backed by a centralised database and automated workflows for Tikovia's business operations. The system delivers intelligent reporting dashboards and inventory forecasting capabilities, personalised per role, and is deployment-ready through Docker and GitHub Actions for continuous integration and delivery. Development also produces AI modules for voice-based data input and order auto-suggestion, route optimisation logic based on distance, time and traffic conditions, AI analytics for evaluating employee performance and detecting operational bottlenecks, and tested data synchronisation between the web and mobile platforms.

SP_08.titleEn: BI2C - Building a Web Platform for Purchasing, Exchanging and Selling Bicycles and Bicycle Accessories and Bicycle Repair Services using Next.js, Spring Boot and PostgreSQL
SP_08.description: The bicycle and bicycle repair service market in Vietnam operates mainly through traditional physical stores, non-specialised classified sites and social media. There is no centralised, reliable platform for the complex transactions the sector requires, such as purchasing, trading in used bikes and scheduling professional repair services. Existing processes are largely manual, pricing of used vehicles lacks transparency, and users find it difficult to search for information about new and used bikes or to track the progress of repairs and orders. BI2C addresses this by building a modern web platform that digitises and centralises the entire value chain of the bicycle industry, including sales of new and used bikes, trade-in exchange and repair services, with automatic valuation, transaction management, secure online payment and AI chat support.
SP_08.objective: The general objective is to build a centralised modern web platform using Next.js and Spring Boot that digitises the entire value chain of the bicycle industry covering purchasing, exchanging, selling new and used products and providing professional repair services. Specific objectives are to optimise the automatic valuation process for used bicycles and accessories so that transactions become transparent, to streamline transaction management across orders, trade-ins and sales posts, to enhance the user experience with integrated features such as secure online payment and AI chat support, and to establish a comprehensive management system that allows administrators to control products, inventory and services and to generate sales reports.
SP_08.scope: The platform serves four roles. Administrators manage users, roles and permissions, approve shop registrations, manage categories and brands, manage platform products and warehouse inventory, approve used listings, manage coupons, process refunds, manage CMS content, moderate shop products, promotions and community posts and view dashboards, statistics and data exports. Customers register, log in, reset passwords, manage profiles and address books and verify accounts, then search, filter and browse new and used products, view details, compare products, add to wishlist, browse by shop, manage carts, apply coupons, check out with a chosen payment method, place and track orders and cancel before shipment. They can also post, edit and remove used listings on the C2C marketplace, chat with sellers, rate sellers and report violations, view service packages, browse repair shops, book and manage repair appointments, rate services and participate in the user community with community-to-marketplace linking. Shops register and track their application status, manage shop profiles, products and catalogues, repair services and appointment calendars, shop orders, storefront pages, promotions and offers, community posts, buyer chat and verification badges. Guests can search, filter and browse products, view details and shop catalogues, view service packages, browse repair shops and read the community in read-only mode.
SP_08.technology: Next.js, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions
SP_08.expectedResult: The expected outcome is a working centralised web platform covering the whole bicycle value chain, with a full role model of administrators, customers, shops and guests. It delivers e-commerce for new products with cart, coupon, checkout, order tracking and cancellation flows, a C2C marketplace for used goods with listing management, direct chat, seller ratings and violation reporting, a repair and maintenance module with service packages, shop discovery, appointment booking and post-service reviews, and a community area linked to the marketplace. The system also produces an automatic valuation mechanism for used bicycles to ensure pricing transparency, JWT-supported authentication, secure online payment, AI chat support and a comprehensive administrative back office covering inventory, moderation, coupons, refunds, CMS content and sales statistics.

SP_09.titleEn: RCET Lab - Building a Website to Promote and Manage the Robotics, Chips and Emerging Technologies Lab of FPT University Danang Campus using React, Node.js (Express) and SQL Server
SP_09.description: The Robotics, Chips and Emerging Technologies Lab has recently been founded at FPT University Danang Campus and currently has no tool at all with which to promote itself or to manage its activities. Information about the Lab's publications, conferences, journals, members, books, products and prototypes is not published anywhere in an organised form, and the projects the Lab runs have no shared place for code, reports, results, meeting schedules or master plans. For these reasons the Head of Lab requested a website, and the project builds a client-driven system that introduces the Lab's information, promotes its achievements and manages its activities, with every feature implemented according to the requirements of the Head of Lab.
SP_09.objective: The project aims to build a website that introduces the Lab's information, promotes the Lab's achievements and manages the Lab's activities. Specific objectives are to publish and maintain the Lab's profile including publications, international conferences, journals, members, books, products and prototypes; to provide project-management tools for each of the Lab's projects covering code, reports, results, meeting schedules and master plans; to enforce a role-based access system across the Head of Research Institute, Head of Lab, administrators, project managers and project members; to provide a training section for members and collaborators together with tests that are marked automatically; to integrate an AI feature that supports report synthesising; and to deliver an admin dashboard with a moderation panel.
SP_09.scope: The website serves five roles. The Head of Research Institute has full access to all features of the website except source code. The Head of Lab has full access to all projects except source code and can create training materials. Administrators manage users, roles and permissions and control global settings and the configuration panel. Project managers have full authority over and access to the project they manage. Project members have full access to the project they participate in and can create training materials within their specialty. Shared features include notifications for important events. The functional scope covers the Lab information portal, per-project management of code, reports, results, meeting schedules and master plans, the training section with automatically marked tests, AI-assisted report synthesis and the administration dashboard. Non-functional scope requires responsive design with toast notifications and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, a maximum response time under one second with support for 500 concurrent users, and 99.5% uptime with fallback and recovery strategies.
SP_09.technology: React, HTML, CSS, Node.js, Express.js, SQL Server, Git, GitHub Actions
SP_09.expectedResult: Because the requirements have been provided by the client, the research concentrates on optimising the tasks of the website, integrating AI into the product and deploying the system. The expected output is a fully functional website containing the Lab's information covering publications, international conferences, journals, members, books, products and prototypes, project-management tools for each project of the Lab covering code, reports, results, meeting schedules and master plans, a role-based access system, a training section for members and collaborators, tests for learners with automatic marking, an AI feature that supports report synthesising, and an admin dashboard with a moderation panel.

SP_10.titleEn: FigiCore - Developing a Retail and Operations Management System for Collectible Figures using React.js, NestJS and PostgreSQL
SP_10.description: The Vietnamese collectible model market lacks trustworthy retail channels and suffers from high fraud risk, unreliable grey-market sellers and chaotic pre-order processes. Buyers cannot verify authenticity, deposits placed on pre-orders carry real financial risk, and fulfilment offers no proof that the item shipped was the item ordered. FigiCore is a specialised operations system that addresses these trust issues by managing both a physical store and an e-commerce website within one platform. It builds credibility through an anti-fraud fulfilment workflow in which packing staff must upload video evidence and enter seal codes, creating a verifiable trust chain; an automated pre-order system that handles the complex two-stage deposit process and allocates limited stock fairly through a FIFO queuing algorithm; and an internal finance and risk-management layer providing an internal wallet for instant refunds as store credit together with a risk-scoring engine that proactively flags high-risk orders.
SP_10.objective: The core objective is to solve the trust problems of the collectible retail market through three practical, specialised functions. Anti-fraud fulfilment enforces a packing workflow that requires video evidence and seal-code entry so that every shipment carries verifiable proof. The automated pre-order system manages two-stage deposits and allocates scarce stock fairly using an automated FIFO queue with a payment deadline. Internal finance and risk management provides an internal wallet that enables instant refunds as store credit and a rule-based risk-scoring engine that flags high-risk orders for manual review. Supporting objectives include unifying a physical store and an e-commerce website under one backend and delivering a data-driven anti-duplicate mechanism for blindbox purchases.
SP_10.scope: The system consists of three web clients on a unified backend: a public e-commerce site for customers, an admin dashboard for super administrators and operations staff, and a POS application for store staff, serving five user groups. Customers register and verify by OTP, search and filter by category, series and rarity, place standard in-stock orders, place pre-orders with partial deposits and receive automated notifications when stock arrives, pay the balance through a unique payment link, benefit from an anti-duplicate smart blindbox algorithm that checks purchase history, pay via VNPAY, VietQR or the internal wallet, view wallet balance and full transaction history and consign items through a C2B2C authenticated auction workflow. POS staff log in with staff credentials, check out using a barcode scanner, process cash, card or wallet payments, print receipts and check local inventory. Operations staff work the integrated packing station, view the queue of confirmed orders and complete the enforced anti-fraud packing workflow. Administrators manage accounts and RBAC permissions, create and edit products with type and deposit rate, manage the pre-order queue by entering incoming stock and triggering the FIFO algorithm, monitor the 48-hour payment deadline dashboard, oversee all system transactions, review orders flagged by the risk-scoring engine and generate sales, inventory and deposit-liability reports.
SP_10.technology: React.js, NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Docker, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Vercel, Render, VNPAY, GHN
SP_10.expectedResult: The project delivers a public e-commerce web application, an admin dashboard and a POS web application on a shared backend, with complex data models for in-stock and pre-order products, standard and deposit orders, internal wallets and transaction ledgers, consignment flows and fraud evidence. Research outputs cover workflows and database models for storing anti-fraud evidence, background task scheduling with cron jobs and state management for the FIFO queue, data-driven algorithms for anti-duplicate blindbox logic and rule-based risk scoring, secure handling of asynchronous third-party webhooks for payment IPN and shipping status, and consignment workflow models with item authentication. Testing validates the logical accuracy of the pre-order FIFO algorithm and the anti-duplicate logic, the security and ACID integrity of the internal wallet, and overall usability, reliability and scalability. Future enhancements identified include an AI collector concierge chatbot using RAG and LLMs and live hardware integration of webcams and barcode scanners at the packing station.

SP_11.titleEn: HOMS - Building a Household Furniture Moving Management System using ReactJS, NodeJS and MongoDB
SP_11.description: The Household Furniture and Goods Moving Management System is a robust, user-friendly web platform for companies that provide moving services to households. Moving companies today coordinate orders, furniture inventories, vehicles and crews through disconnected manual processes, which makes it hard to match the right vehicle and staff to a job, to keep customers informed and to learn anything useful from operational history. HOMS supports the full process from receiving customer orders and managing furniture items through assigning vehicles and staff and tracking delivery to collecting feedback. It provides a modular system covering furniture management with size, weight, fragility and images, order creation and tracking, vehicle and staff management, the delivery workflow and evaluation, and dashboard analytics for orders, staff performance and demand trends, with optional AI services to suggest optimal staff and vehicles, predict delivery time and analyse operational efficiency.
SP_11.objective: The project aims to optimise the furniture and goods moving workflow by giving customers, dispatchers and delivery staff a user-friendly platform on which to create, track and manage moving orders in real time. It seeks to enhance collaboration between all parties through a secure online workspace supporting communication, assignment updates and real-time status tracking; to ensure secure role-based access control and data privacy across customer, dispatcher, delivery staff and administrator roles; to improve vehicle and staff allocation efficiency through automated assignment, scheduling and real-time notifications; to enable real-time order tracking and post-completion feedback; to apply a modular architecture that separates orders, furniture, vehicles, staff and workflow into independent logical modules for maintainability and long-term scalability; and to provide analytics and reporting on total orders, staff performance, popular items and demand per area to support business decisions.
SP_11.scope: The scope covers seven functional modules within a responsive web application. Furniture management provides full CRUD over household items including name, category, weight, dimensions, fragility level and images, with grouping into categories such as furniture, electronics and fragile goods to support accurate transportation planning. Order management lets users create, edit, cancel and track moving orders storing pickup and delivery locations, time, item lists and transportation conditions. Vehicle management covers CRUD over vehicles including type, load capacity, cargo space and availability schedule, with automatic checks of vehicle suitability against the weight and dimensions of the items. Staff management covers staff profiles, skills and work schedules and lets dispatchers assign staff to orders. The delivery workflow, customer order tracking and history with detailed timelines, delivery confirmation, support requests and service rating, and operational management for administrators and staff complete the scope, the latter allowing administrators to monitor active requests, assign vehicles and staff, adjust schedules and resolve conflicts such as overloaded routes or staff shortages. Research scope additionally covers CSV and Excel import and export, data consistency across modules, communication flows and dashboard visualisation.
SP_11.technology: ReactJS, Node.js, MongoDB, GitHub, GitHub Actions
SP_11.expectedResult: The expected result is a responsive web application for customers, dispatchers, delivery staff and administrators built with ReactJS and Node.js, structured as a modular monolith with clearly separated logical modules for user management, furniture management, order processing, vehicle and staff management and the delivery workflow. It integrates CSV and Excel import and export for moving orders, furniture lists and operational data and prepares integration points for external AI services such as automated vehicle assignment and route estimation. Key features delivered include user management, furniture catalogue management, moving order creation and tracking, vehicle and staff scheduling, delivery workflow management, notifications, document sharing for images and receipts, analytics dashboards and feedback and rating functionality, all under role-based access control. Deliverables also include architectural design documentation, UI/UX design, functional specifications, user manuals and implementation and deployment guides.

SP_12.titleEn: ERMS - Building a Small and Medium Enterprise Resource Planning System using ReactJS, ASP.NET Core Web API and Microsoft SQL Server
SP_12.description: In modern enterprises, managing human resources effectively is crucial for maintaining productivity and competitiveness, yet two core aspects - recruitment and internal training - are usually handled manually or through disconnected systems. The result is inefficiency, data inconsistency and very limited ability to track performance across the employee lifecycle. This project builds a web-based Enterprise Resource Management System that centralises recruitment and internal training management, supporting online job posting, candidate tracking, employee onboarding, training plan management and progress evaluation. It additionally integrates AI-based resume screening and intelligent skill-gap analysis to optimise both recruitment and employee development, and serves HR managers, department heads and employees through dedicated interfaces for each role so that decisions can be made from data and the workforce improved continuously.
SP_12.objective: The project aims to develop an integrated web platform that manages recruitment and internal training processes end to end. It supports job posting, online candidate applications and interview tracking; automates resume screening using AI-based keyword and skill matching; manages employee training programmes including registration, attendance and assessment; generates analytical reports on hiring efficiency and training outcomes; enhances HR decision-making with AI-based insights and performance analytics; and improves collaboration between HR, managers and employees through transparent workflows.
SP_12.scope: The system explicitly includes management of the recruitment process covering job postings, candidate applications, interviews and hiring; management of internal training programmes covering course creation, enrolment, tracking and evaluation; AI integration for resume screening and training recommendations; dashboards for HR, managers and employees; reports on recruitment performance and training outcomes; and support for notifications, approval workflows and user authentication. The scope explicitly excludes payroll, attendance tracking and employee performance appraisal outside the training context, as well as integrations with external job boards such as the LinkedIn API. Modules to be developed are recruitment management, AI-powered resume analysis and candidate ranking, internal training management, performance tracking and feedback, reporting and analytics for HR and management, and role-based dashboards for the HR manager, trainer and employee. Basic AI logic such as keyword extraction and ranking may be developed in-house while advanced NLP features leverage pre-trained APIs or AI cloud services.
SP_12.technology: ReactJS, ASP.NET Core Web API, SQL Server, Azure Repos, Azure Pipelines, NLP
SP_12.expectedResult: The final expected output is a complete web-based Enterprise Resource Management System that integrates AI to enhance recruitment and internal training. It delivers recruitment management with posting, application, interview scheduling and status tracking, AI-based resume screening and ranking, internal training management with course planning, registration and attendance, AI skill-gap analysis with course recommendation, an HR dashboard with analytics and reports, an employee dashboard with training history and feedback, notifications and workflow approvals, and data-driven decision support for HR departments. The system is expected to improve HR efficiency, ensure transparency in employee development and support strategic workforce planning through intelligent analytics.

SP_13.titleEn: EduConnect (FUEC) - Developing an AI-Integrated Educational Ecosystem for Learning, Testing and Academic Discussion on Web to Support Exam Management and Organization at FPT University using VueJS, ASP.NET and MySQL
SP_13.description: EduConnect is an AI-integrated educational ecosystem that brings learning, testing and academic discussion together on a single web platform to support exam management and organisation at FPT University. Traditional online examination lacks reliable safeguards against impersonation and cheating, exam administration consumes large amounts of lecturer time in building question banks, scheduling and grading, and students have no single place in which to review materials, discuss academically and track their own progress. The system responds with an AI-based proctoring mechanism combining face recognition, gaze tracking and behavioural analysis inside a secure web environment, automated tools for question bank management, exam scheduling and instant grading, a centralised student area for materials, discussion and progress tracking, and data analytics that detect learning gaps and suggest personalised improvement paths.
SP_13.objective: The project aims to uphold academic integrity by enhancing the transparency and security of FPT University's examinations through AI-based proctoring using face recognition, gaze tracking and behavioural analysis integrated into a secure web environment. It aims to streamline exam administration by supporting lecturers and exam officers with automated tools for question bank management, exam scheduling and instant grading; to centralise student activities so that students can review materials, participate in academic discussions and track learning progress seamlessly through the web interface; and to personalise learning with AI by leveraging data analytics to detect learning gaps, prevent academic dishonesty and suggest personalised improvement paths.
SP_13.scope: The system covers a guest site with registration, login and password recovery plus public information about exams, courses and forum posts; an admin site managing accounts for administrators, teachers, proctors and students, exams, schedules and question banks, AI cheating alerts and violation verification, dashboards, reports and system logs, AI monitoring configuration and data backup; a teacher site for creating and managing multiple-choice and essay question banks, generating randomised exams, importing and exporting questions via Excel or Word, using AI to auto-generate questions from PDF and DOCX study materials and reviewing student performance, exam analytics and AI violation logs; a student site for secure identity-verified login, access to materials, feedback and personalised learning suggestions, academic discussion and forum Q&A, taking official exams under AI supervision with camera and microphone and receiving automatic grading for multiple-choice questions; and a proctor site for real-time exam monitoring, instant AI cheating alerts, live student video feeds and evidence management. AI monitoring covers real-time face detection and ID verification, gaze and motion tracking, multi-person detection, voice-activity and sound-anomaly detection, alert classification into mild, medium and severe levels and timestamped evidence recording. Security scope covers AES and RSA encryption of exam data, regular backups, activity logging and audit trails and an English and Vietnamese interface.
SP_13.technology: VueJS, ReactJS, .NET Web API, MySQL, WebSocket, Python, ONNX Runtime (DirectML), OpenCV, ML.NET, OpenRouter, Clean Architecture, Git, AWS DevOps
SP_13.expectedResult: The expected outputs are an AI-integrated proctoring system providing real-time face and voice monitoring to ensure exam fairness, automated evaluation and feedback with immediate grading, analytics and personalised AI feedback, data-driven learning insights that track progress and suggest study improvements, a scalable, secure and accessible system operating seamlessly across web environments, and comprehensive reporting covering performance reports, cheating summaries and activity logs. Research outputs cover Clean Architecture layering, WebSocket real-time communication, deployment of Python-trained face-detection and gaze-tracking models into the .NET ecosystem through ONNX Runtime and ML.NET for local real-time inference, computer vision and audio processing with OpenCV for behavioural and audio anomaly detection, generative AI integration through OpenRouter for automated question generation and personalised feedback, and cryptographic standards with secure authentication flows. Optional advanced features include AI-generated practice exams, adaptive exam difficulty, payment integration, smart scheduling to avoid exam overlap and voice-based proctoring.

SP_14.titleEn: OISS - Building an Online Interview Practice Support System using ASP.NET Core Web API, ReactJS and PostgreSQL
SP_14.description: Candidates in the information technology sector, especially developers, face several concrete difficulties when preparing for interviews. They cannot find a realistic and professional practice environment that simulates a real technical interview with a code editor and real-time video and audio communication; current practice tools do not provide an integrated live code editor, which is essential for technical interviews; and self-practice methods lack the in-depth, comprehensive and objective evaluation that only experienced industry coaches can give. The Online Interview Practice Support System is developed to address these issues by providing a comprehensive platform on which candidates can practise, learn and prepare effectively for interviews at technology companies, combining virtual interview rooms, a shared question bank and structured coach feedback.
SP_14.objective: The project aims to create a professional practice environment by building a web platform that offers a realistic online interview setting supporting technical interview sessions with real-time video and audio communication. It aims to integrate core technical tools by developing virtual interview rooms with an embedded live code editor that meets the specific requirements of technical interviews; to provide quality feedback by establishing a comprehensive, in-depth and objective evaluation process delivered by experienced industry coaches; to support multiple roles by building a complete system serving candidates, coaches and administrators; and to develop a comprehensive management system with modules for interview schedules, personal profiles and the question bank so that the platform operates transparently and efficiently.
SP_14.scope: The system covers authentication and authorisation through email registration and login, OTP email verification and logout. Administrators manage user and coach accounts including viewing, verifying and deactivating them, approve blog posts sharing interview experiences, manage the question bank, access an analytics and reporting dashboard and send notifications related to content approval. Candidates manage personal information and reset passwords, join virtual interview rooms with real-time video and audio built on WebRTC and SignalR, book interviews with coaches by selecting available time slots and receiving confirmations, access learning resources including experience blogs and the question bank, contribute their own blog posts subject to admin approval, use a resume review service by uploading a CV and choosing between a written report or a one-to-one video call, receive and give feedback and ratings after sessions, revisit previous sessions through a personal repository and receive notifications about schedule updates. Coaches manage their profiles, accept or decline booking requests, conduct interviews in the virtual room, provide feedback and view their own ratings, conduct one-to-one resume review calls and access a dashboard with statistics such as number of interviews and completion rate. General system features cover the interview lifecycle from Requested through Accepted, Scheduled, Ongoing to Completed, secure media storage and real-time notifications.
SP_14.technology: ReactJS, ASP.NET Core Web API, PostgreSQL, WebRTC, SignalR, GitHub, GitHub Actions
SP_14.expectedResult: The project delivers a comprehensive web platform providing a realistic interview practice environment for IT candidates, developed with ASP.NET Core Web API on the back end and ReactJS on the front end. Research outputs include needs analysis, a system architecture designed around the three main roles of candidate, coach and administrator, and implementation of core features such as mock interviews, the question bank and structured feedback. The delivered system provides virtual interview rooms with real-time video, audio and a live code editor, an interview scheduling and lifecycle management module, a resume review service, a personal analytics repository for reviewing past sessions, a blog and question bank knowledge area with admin moderation, and an AI question-collection feature that captures questions asked during an interview and, once confirmed by the coach, saves them to the question bank marked as collected by AI.

SP_15.titleEn: Petties - Veterinary Appointment Booking Platform using Flutter, React Vite, Spring Boot, Python and PostgreSQL
SP_15.description: Pet owners face repeated difficulties when their pets need medical care. Visiting a veterinary clinic in the traditional way is inconvenient, time-consuming and stressful for both the animal and the owner, and owners struggle to find qualified veterinarians who make home visits, to schedule appointments easily while managing several pets, to ensure timely treatment and follow-up, and to pay securely online. Petties develops a modern home veterinary booking system that connects pet owners with professional veterinarians, enhancing the experience through real-time booking, appointment management, secure online payment and continuous health monitoring so that owners receive timely notifications and their pets receive continuous care at home, supported by a centralised electronic medical record shared across clinics.
SP_15.objective: The project aims to provide a platform through which pet owners can book home visits from veterinarians, to support real-time booking and appointment management between owners and clinic veterinarians, to enable veterinarians to manage schedules, set service fees and track earnings, to implement secure online payments for home veterinary services, to offer an administrative dashboard that monitors appointments, users and transactions, and to enhance the user experience by providing notifications, reminders and pet health management tips.
SP_15.scope: The platform spans a web application and mobile applications for iOS and Android. Pet-owner scope covers pet profile management with photos, breed, age and physical characteristics, a centralised electronic medical record accessible and updatable by authorised doctors and merchants across locations, a digital vaccination tracker, advanced search and filtering of doctors, clinics and pet-care shops by geolocation, specialty, rating and price range, flexible appointment booking with a choice between in-clinic and at-home service, SOS emergency booking that finds the nearest available online doctor, in-app video consultation, electronic prescribing saved to the pet record, and medication and appointment reminders. Clinic and doctor scope covers staff and shift management for rosters across multiple doctors, appointment request management with approve, reject or reschedule options, a daily operations dashboard, appointment check-in and check-out, and dynamic distance-based pricing configurable by travel radius for home visits. Cross-cutting scope covers a ratings and reviews system, an AI-powered booking assistant chatbot that answers pet-care questions and completes bookings through natural language, notifications by email, SMS and push, analytics and reporting on bookings, revenue, occupancy and sentiment, and multi-language support with region-specific date, currency and address formats.
SP_15.technology: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Flutter, Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Python, FastAPI, WebSocket, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Qdrant, FastMCP, AWS S3, Cloudinary, Docker, Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions
SP_15.expectedResult: The research examines the problems pet owners face when booking home veterinary services and analyses how digital solutions can improve the process, studying booking workflows, online payments, communication features and AI-based health monitoring in order to design an efficient and user-friendly system. The expected output is a mobile application that allows pet owners to book home visits, manage their pets, receive health updates, make online payments and interact with veterinarians, complemented by dashboards for veterinarians and administrators, a notification system and expanded modules such as e-commerce and community interaction.

SP_16.titleEn: GZMart - An AI-Powered E-Commerce and Mini-ERP Platform for Fashion Retailers using ReactJS, NodeJS and MongoDB
SP_16.description: The Vietnamese e-commerce market is seeing an explosion of cross-border models, particularly in the fast-fashion niche imported from Guangzhou, China, where thousands of individual sellers operate order and pre-order models on social media with average monthly revenues of ten to fifty million VND while working entirely manually and without specialised management tools. Three critical gaps define the problem. Financial opacity means sellers only estimate product costs and, because exchange rates fluctuate and international shipping fees are complex, cannot calculate accurate landed cost, so thirty to forty percent of sellers miscalculate their real profit margins. Operational fragmentation means order consolidation, purchasing and shipment tracking are performed manually through Excel and Zalo without synchronisation to retail inventory, costing sellers fifteen to twenty hours per week in data entry and reconciliation. Inventory risk means purchasing is driven by intuition rather than data, producing dead-stock rates of thirty to forty percent. The target users are shop owners aged eighteen to thirty-five handling one hundred to five hundred products monthly, and their Gen Z female buyers.
SP_16.objective: GZMart aims to build an all-in-one platform combining an e-commerce front end for selling with a mini-ERP back end for import management. Its first objective is financial transparency through automatic calculation of accurate landed cost based on actual costs including product cost, international shipping, customs, domestic delivery and service fees. The second is operational consolidation of pre-order and purchase-order management, structured SKU management and inventory and warehouse receiving in one synchronised system. The third is AI-driven business optimisation, using AI to forecast restocking needs through restock alerts and to automate customer care.
SP_16.scope: The platform covers four sites. The guest site provides registration, login, password recovery and display of all available products with sorting and filtering. The seller site is the operations and ERP centre, covering advanced pre-order and purchase-order management, automated landed-cost calculation for accurate profit reporting, AI-based restock prediction and trend forecasting, structured SKU management and workflow tracking, inventory management with a warehouse receiving process and bulk product upload with automatic category detection through Google Vision API. The buyer site covers smart product browsing with search, filter and cart, personalised recommendations using content-based and simple collaborative filtering, order tracking with pre-order delivery estimation, payment gateway integration, an AI chatbot for automated support and a wishlist. The admin site covers user management and system configuration, content monitoring, order and product oversight, platform analytics and financial reporting and dispute resolution. Optional advanced scope includes subscription and VIP models, personalised homepage feeds, intelligent pricing suggestions, visual search through product image recognition and logistics integration with real-time tracking.
SP_16.technology: ReactJS, Bootstrap, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Socket.io, OpenAI API, Google Gemini API, Google Cloud Vision API, Prophet, GitHub, Azure
SP_16.expectedResult: The expected result is a working all-in-one platform combining e-commerce and mini-ERP capabilities for cross-border fashion sellers. AI components are delivered with defined evaluation criteria: trend prediction and restock alerts using Prophet or moving averages on at least three to six months of sales history with a target MAPE below twenty percent, falling back to simple moving averages with synthetic data during the MVP phase; an AI chatbot built on OpenAI or Gemini APIs that automates customer service and provides size and colour consultation through context injection from the product database and order history; automatic product categorisation using Google Cloud Vision API with target accuracy above eighty-five percent; and a hybrid recommendation engine combining content-based cosine similarity over category, style, colour and price attributes with a frequency-counting collaborative approach, evaluated by Precision@10 and a click-through rate above three percent. The platform also delivers a seller dashboard for products, orders and sales with revenue and performance statistics, guaranteed compatibility across devices and a responsive interface.

SP_17.titleEn: Ashen Light (ASL) - Building an RPG Game using Unity with NPC Interaction through AI and Player Support Based on Local Data using Unity UI, ASP.NET APIs and SQL Server
SP_17.description: Ashen Light is an AI-enhanced role-playing game developed in Unity, designed to deliver an immersive and adaptive gameplay experience through intelligent NPC interaction and dynamic enemy behaviour. The game integrates an AI-driven conversation system that lets NPCs respond naturally to player actions, offer quests and adapt their dialogue to the narrative context. Alongside this it features an adaptive combat framework in which enemy behaviour evolves from player-generated data, so that opponents learn from player strategies and adjust their tactics in real time. A deliberate design constraint is offline resilience: the player can choose between algorithm-based and AI-driven NPC behaviour, and the game automatically falls back to algorithmic behaviour when no internet connection is available.
SP_17.objective: The core objective is to create a living, responsive RPG world in which artificial intelligence enhances storytelling, exploration and combat. By combining Unity's real-time engine with machine-learning models for NPC dialogue and enemy adaptation, the game aims to offer personalised difficulty balancing, emergent enemy strategies and a deeper sense of player agency. The system includes tools for data collection, behavioural analysis and dynamic AI updates so that enemies and NPCs remain engaging throughout the player's journey. Ultimately the project strives to deliver a modern AI-powered RPG experience that blends narrative depth, intelligent interaction and adaptive gameplay in a world that evolves according to the player's choices, actions and playstyle.
SP_17.scope: Player scope covers registration, login and character profile management including class, stats, equipment and skills, character creation with name, appearance, stats and starting weapon, world exploration, combat, quest completion and loot collection, NPC interaction through either standard dialogue or AI-generated dynamic responses with a player-selectable behaviour mode that falls back to algorithmic behaviour offline, AI-powered quest recommendation based on playstyle, combat history and exploration patterns, an AI companion system in which companions are recruited after completing their personal questlines and then assist in combat, gathering, healing and navigation while issuing their own quests, procedural NPC spawning driven by player behaviour, inventory, equipment and crafting management, quest tracking across main, side, AI-generated and companion quests, an AI chatbot for gameplay tips and lore, progression management and world interaction. The NPC system scope covers dynamic NPC matching to player behaviour and threat level, dynamic spawning of allies, enemies and neutrals based on world conditions, quest-giving NPC behaviour, personality-driven interaction with emotion, attitude change and memory of player choices, and difficulty screening that scales NPC stats, intelligence, aggression and loot quality. Supporting scope covers online payment through a secure gateway, user information management, persistent story questlines, player reporting, data synchronisation of character data and AI model logs, progress tracking, NPC population management, combat log analysis, world state management and administrative player session control.
SP_17.technology: Unity, Unity UI, Unity Engine APIs, Razor View, ASP.NET Web API, SQL Server, JWT, Google Gemini API, PayOS, Git
SP_17.expectedResult: The expected result is a playable Unity RPG combining an AI-driven NPC conversation system with an adaptive combat framework, backed by an ASP.NET API service and SQL Server data layer. The game delivers persistent fixed story questlines with pre-written objectives, cutscenes and events alongside AI-generated quests, an AI companion system with recruitment through personal questlines, dynamic NPC and enemy spawning and difficulty scaling driven by player data, and an AI chatbot for gameplay assistance and world knowledge. Supporting deliverables include algorithm-based fallback behaviours for companions and enemies that operate without an internet connection, secure online payment through PayOS, user and character data synchronisation with the backend, combat log analysis that adjusts difficulty and offers advice, world state management, player progress tracking and administrative tools for player reporting and session control.

SP_18.titleEn: MSDTC - Building a Management System for Driving Training Centers in Da Nang City using NextJS, .NET C#, SQL Server and MongoDB
SP_18.description: Driving training centres in Da Nang City currently manage students, instructors, courses, payments and training processes mainly through manual or semi-digital systems. The consequence is scattered data, low transparency, slow operations and real difficulty in tracking student progress across theory, practice and examinations. This project builds a centralised, modern web-based management platform that supports the end-to-end operations of a driving training centre, covering enrolment, training management, scheduling, teacher coordination, online testing and financial tracking, and extending to a collaborator referral programme through which the centre recruits new students and pays commission transparently.
SP_18.objective: The general objectives are to develop a unified website system for managing driving centres, to digitise the learning process across theory, practice, scheduling and exam management, to provide online enrolment, online payment via QR code and mock test functions, to improve transparency, training quality and management efficiency, and to support multiple user roles with appropriate permission levels. The specific objectives are to automate student enrolment, attendance and learning-progress tracking, to support teachers in managing lessons, attendance and student evaluations, to enable training managers to manage exams, tests, notifications and QR fee collection, to provide a collaborator referral system with tokens and commission tracking, and to enable administrators to control finances, system data and overall operations.
SP_18.scope: The system serves five roles. Administrators manage the entire system, configure user accounts and permissions, create and publish enrolment posts, manage recruitment campaigns, manage collaborators together with their performance reports and referral system, manage driving courses and global course content, oversee all financial information and revenue reports and monitor activity logs and data consistency. Trainer managers manage courses and subjects across theory and practice, build training roadmaps and learning pathways, manage class schedules and training sessions, manage exam dates, test content and exam materials, publish system-wide notifications, manage instructor profiles and assignment schedules, manage student profiles, attendance and progress, generate QR codes for tuition payments and track training performance. Instructors take attendance in theory and practical classes, upload and manage teaching materials, record scores and evaluations, view assigned classes and schedules and communicate announcements. Enrolment managers receive referral codes or tokens, share referral links, track successful registrations, view commission and reward details and handle commission distribution. Students register for courses, check attendance and learning progress, view course contents, lessons and video lectures, view learning and examination schedules, pay online via QR code, take online mock tests and view exam scores and notifications. Non-functional scope requires toast notifications for all system messages and accessible colour contrast with a minimum body font size of fourteen pixels.
SP_18.technology: Next.js, .NET (C#), ASP.NET Web API, RESTful API, SQL Server, MongoDB, JWT
SP_18.expectedResult: The expected output is a centralised web platform digitising the full operation of driving training centres in Da Nang. It delivers authentication with role-based permissions, course and global content management, financial dashboards and reporting and system configuration for administrators; course, subject, training-roadmap, class-schedule and exam management with QR tuition-payment generation, teacher and student profile management and training-progress dashboards for trainer managers; attendance taking, material upload, lecture and document management, score entry and announcement sending for instructors; enrolment post creation, collaborator management, referral tracking and commission calculation for the recruitment side; and course registration, attendance history, learning roadmap, exam schedules, QR tuition payment, online mock tests and exam results for students.

SP_19.titleEn: ORA - Online Dual-Mode Roguelite Game Design with AI Assistance using Photon Fusion 2
SP_19.description: ORA is a fast-paced online roguelite game that combines AI-assisted weapon generation with two distinct gameplay modes: cooperative PvE dungeon runs and balanced PvP arena combat. The project explores how generative AI can enhance player creativity and content scalability in a game context, letting players create unique weapons from prompts rather than choosing from a fixed catalogue, while Photon Fusion 2 provides the real-time multiplayer networking that makes both modes playable online. A companion website supports the game with user management and game services, so that accounts, profiles, item browsing and player statistics live outside the client.
SP_19.objective: The objective is to design and build a fast-paced online roguelite game that combines AI-assisted weapon generation with dual gameplay modes covering PvE dungeon runs and balanced PvP combat. The project aims to deliver an accessible and highly replayable experience while demonstrating how AI can enhance player creativity and content scalability, and to support the game with a companion website providing user management and game services. Supporting objectives include implementing core gameplay mechanics for dungeon runs, combat and player progression, developing multiplayer networking with Photon Fusion 2 for real-time online play, and building AI tools that generate weapon designs, statistics and variations.
SP_19.scope: Game scope covers lobby and matchmaking allowing players to create or join rooms and auto-match for PvE or PvP, AI-assisted weapon generation from player prompts, a PvE roguelite dungeon mode with randomised maps, enemies, minibosses and boss encounters, a PvP arena mode with real-time online combat and balanced stats between players, a real-time action combat and movement system with skills, dodging and directional aiming, inventory and equipment management for weapons, items and loadouts, player profiles with statistics and customisation, a progression system unlocking chapters, improving stats and earning rewards, an in-game shop selling skins and visual effects, and achievements and leaderboards.
