Website scope covers authentication and account management with registration, login and profile management, an item and weapon browser for viewing AI-generated weapons and in-game items, a player dashboard showing statistics, owned items and progression, support tools providing game information, FAQs and updates, user management with ban and unban capability and content and item control for adjusting item availability, events and announcements.
SP_19.technology: Unity, Photon Fusion 2, Next.js, .NET, Python, MySQL, Redis, GitHub, GitHub Actions
SP_19.expectedResult: The expected outputs are a working game prototype featuring AI-generated weapons, a playable PvE dungeon mode and a balanced online PvP mode, together with functional systems for matchmaking, lobbies, combat, inventory and in-game progression. The project also delivers a companion website supporting login, player profiles, item exploration and game service integration, and documentation covering game design, AI integration, the networking workflow and implementation results.

SP_20.titleEn: NETA - Developing a Nutrition and Exercise Tracking Mobile Application using React Native (Expo), Express.js and MongoDB
SP_20.description: NETA is a mobile application designed to help users monitor their daily nutrition and exercise routines effectively. Most people who want to lose weight, gain muscle or simply maintain a healthy lifestyle have to juggle separate tools for food logging and workout tracking, which makes it hard to see the relationship between what they eat and what they burn. The system lets users log meals, calculate calories and nutrients and record workout sessions such as strength or cardio training in one place, providing personalised insights and progress tracking that support their goals. By combining diet and exercise management in a single platform the application also promotes better health awareness, making it suitable for individuals seeking to improve their physical fitness and overall well-being, with optional trainer supervision.
SP_20.objective: The project aims to develop a user-friendly mobile platform that lets users track daily nutrition and workout activities in one integrated system. It enables users to log meals, calculate calorie and macronutrient intake and monitor body progress over time; supports recording and analysis of workout sessions covering duration, repetitions, calories burned and exercise types; provides personalised recommendations and daily goals based on user information such as age, weight, height and activity level; displays intuitive dashboards and progress charts that help users visualise improvements in health and fitness; and encourages healthy habits and balanced lifestyles through reminders, challenges and consistent tracking.
SP_20.scope: The application serves three roles. Administrators manage user accounts with lock, unlock, update and password reset options, manage the food and exercise database including nutrition data and workout templates, create and manage standardised meal and workout plan templates, approve trainer registrations and verify credentials, review reports and inappropriate content and send system-wide announcements, updates and maintenance alerts. Trainers create and update professional profiles including experience, specialisation and certifications, view assigned users and track their progress and logs, design and assign custom meal or workout plans, provide feedback and adjustments on daily activities, communicate with users through an integrated chat system and access summary reports of user performance, calorie intake and workout results. Individual users create and update personal information such as age, height, weight and goals, log meals and calculate calorie and nutrient intake, record workout sessions with duration, sets, reps and calories burned, set fitness objectives such as weight loss, muscle gain or maintenance with daily targets, view a progress dashboard with calorie balance, exercise summaries and weight charts, connect with assigned trainers, follow recommended seven to twenty-eight day meal and workout plans generated automatically or assigned by trainers and receive reminders and notifications. Non-functional scope requires a simple intuitive interface optimised for Android and iOS with a responsive layout across screen sizes.
SP_20.technology: React Native (Expo), Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB Atlas, Expo EAS Build, Render, Git/GitHub
SP_20.expectedResult: The research focuses on developing a mobile-based system that supports users in tracking and improving their nutrition and workout routines. The output is a mobile application delivering core features covering user management, meal and calorie tracking, workout logging, progress visualisation and personalised meal and workout plan generation, distributed as an Android APK through Expo EAS Build with the backend deployed on Render and the database hosted on MongoDB Atlas.

SP_21.titleEn: DMS - Building a Student Dormitory Management System at FPT University Danang using ReactJS, NodeJS and MongoDB
SP_21.description: In universities, managing student dormitories is a complex and time-consuming task that involves room allocation, maintenance requests, billing and resident records. Traditional manual processes are inefficient, error-prone and lack transparency, which creates daily operational difficulties for administrators, accountants and maintenance staff alike and leaves students without a clear channel for requests or information. This project builds a web-based Dormitory Management System that digitises and automates these tasks, supporting room allocation, maintenance management, billing and student record tracking. It additionally integrates AI-based facial recognition that automatically identifies residents entering or leaving the dormitory, strengthening both security and operational efficiency, and provides tailored interfaces for administrators, accountants and maintenance staff.
SP_21.objective: The project aims to develop an online platform that manages dormitory operations including room allocation, student registration and billing; to support online requests for room registration, extension and maintenance; to integrate AI-based facial recognition that identifies residents at entry points and records attendance automatically; to enable administrators to monitor occupancy rates, handle maintenance requests and issue announcements; to provide automated billing management for electricity, water and room fees; to generate statistical reports on occupancy, financial data and maintenance activities; and to enhance dormitory security through AI-enabled identity verification and alerts for unauthorised access.
SP_21.scope: The system explicitly includes management of dormitory rooms, student records and assignments; processing of online registration, room transfer and contract extension; tracking of maintenance requests with real-time updates and notifications; billing management for room fees, electricity and water; AI facial recognition for entry and exit tracking and attendance; dashboards for administrators, accountants and maintenance staff; and generation of analytical reports on occupancy, finance and maintenance. The scope explicitly excludes physical security enforcement beyond recognition and alerting, and the management of off-campus accommodation or external facilities. Modules to be developed are room and student management covering assignment, transfer and extension, maintenance request management with tracking and notifications, billing management, AI-based facial recognition for entry, exit and attendance, administrative dashboards and statistical and financial reporting. AI is used both to support requirement gathering, design, code generation and testing during development and, in the product itself, through existing facial-recognition APIs that identify students and analyse attendance patterns.
SP_21.technology: ReactJS, Node.js, MongoDB, GitHub, GitHub Actions, AI facial recognition API
SP_21.expectedResult: The final expected output is a fully functional web-based Dormitory Management System integrating AI facial recognition for automated attendance and access control. It delivers room and student management covering assignments, transfers and extensions, maintenance request management with progress tracking and automated notifications, billing management for accommodation, utilities and additional services, automated check-in and check-out with attendance tracking, an admin dashboard for overall dormitory operations, automatic notifications and announcements for residents, security alerts for unrecognised individuals and reporting and analytics on occupancy rate, maintenance and financial data. The system is expected to enhance management efficiency, ensure transparency in billing and maintenance and strengthen security through AI-based monitoring.

SP_22.titleEn: APRS (CanPany) - Building an AI-Integrated Recruitment Platform for CV Analysis and Job Recommendations Based on Semantic Search and Automatic ATS Evaluation using .NET 8 Web API, ReactJS and MongoDB
SP_22.description: CanPany is a centralised AI-powered recruitment platform designed to streamline and enhance the hiring process for both candidates and companies. Candidates today submit CVs without knowing how applicant tracking systems will score them and without any structured way to improve their profiles, while companies receive large volumes of applications with no reliable ranking. The platform provides intelligent CV analysis including ATS scoring, skill extraction and STAR-based rewriting so candidates can improve their profiles with AI assistance, and offers personalised job recommendations and semantic candidate matching through advanced vector search so both sides discover the most suitable opportunities. Companies create and manage job postings, access AI-ranked candidate lists and interact with applicants through real-time messaging, while premium AI features and job-posting privileges are activated through secure banking payments.
SP_22.objective: The goal of CanPany is to deliver a modern, intelligent and user-friendly recruitment ecosystem that simplifies job discovery, enhances application quality and supports effective hiring decisions powered by artificial intelligence. Concretely the project aims to provide AI-driven CV analysis with ATS scoring, automatic skill extraction, keyword insight and STAR-format rewriting; to build a hybrid recommendation engine that combines semantic vector similarity with collaborative filtering for job recommendation and candidate matching; to give companies a verified job-posting channel with AI-ranked candidate lists and real-time messaging; to operate a transparent premium model activated through secure banking payments; and to provide an administrative dashboard supporting user management, job monitoring, proposal oversight and system-wide analytics.
SP_22.scope: The platform serves four roles. Administrators manage candidate and company accounts, roles and permissions, verify companies by reviewing uploaded business documents before granting posting privileges, moderate all proposals and job postings, monitor AI usage across CV analysis, rewriting, job description generation and vector search, confirm banking payments and activate premium privileges, manage homepage banners with carousel configuration, view a dashboard covering total users, active jobs, monthly growth, premium purchase volume and AI usage, handle system-wide reports and violations and broadcast notifications. Candidates register and manage profiles, receive AI-powered personalised job recommendations based on skills, portfolio, work history and semantic similarity, use the AI CV analyser for ATS scoring, skill extraction, keyword analysis and STAR rewriting under a premium activation, browse and filter jobs by AI relevance scoring, maintain a professional profile with avatar, bio, skills, portfolio, experience and certifications, submit and track proposals, use an AI chatbot, purchase premium packages via banking transfer, request AI rephrasing of CV components, edit and version CVs and synchronise external sources such as LinkedIn or GitHub. Companies register and manage company profiles, receive AI-ranked candidate lists, publish job listings after premium purchase, search candidates by skills, experience, ratings and availability, manage proposals and buy AI screening credits. Guests browse public listings, view limited profiles, try a limited AI CV demo and register to unlock full features.
SP_22.technology: ReactJS, .NET 8 Web API, MongoDB, JWT, Google Gemini API, vector search and embeddings, SePay
SP_22.expectedResult: The expected result is a working AI-integrated recruitment platform delivering the full candidate and company journey. Core deliverables include user registration and login for both candidate and company account types, profile management on both sides, a company verification request and admin approval workflow, CV upload in PDF and DOCX, AI CV analysis producing an ATS score with extracted skills and keyword insights, AI STAR rewriting that converts experience content into Situation-Task-Action-Result form, semantic job recommendation and candidate matching built on embeddings and vector search combined with collaborative filtering, proposal submission and tracking, real-time messaging, an AI chatbot and a banking-based premium activation flow through SePay. The administrative dashboard delivers user, job and proposal oversight, AI usage monitoring, banner management, violation handling and system-wide analytics.

SP_23.titleEn: RestX (RTX) - Developing a Restaurant Business Management Platform using ReactJS, ASP.NET Core and SQL Server
SP_23.description: In the restaurant industry, efficient management of daily operations is crucial to business success, yet many small and medium-sized restaurants still rely on manual processes for order handling, inventory tracking, staff scheduling and revenue monitoring. These fragmented systems lead to operational errors, food waste, poor customer service and very limited business insight. RestX is a comprehensive web-based restaurant management platform that digitises and automates restaurant operations, handling menu management, online ordering, table reservations, real-time inventory tracking, employee scheduling, payment processing and customer relationship management. The platform integrates AI services that provide smart menu recommendations, demand forecasting and data-driven business insights, and implements a database-per-tenant architecture that guarantees complete data isolation and security for each restaurant on the platform.
SP_23.objective: The project aims to build an online platform for comprehensive restaurant operations management; to automate order processing and synchronise it with the kitchen in real time; to automate inventory tracking with recipe-based ingredient deduction; to deliver analytics dashboards covering sales, revenue, customer insights and inventory; to enable customers to make online reservations, view menus, place orders and pay digitally; to offer a visual table layout so customers can choose seats in real time; to integrate AI for personalised food recommendations, demand prediction and data analysis; and to develop an administrative interface through which restaurant managers configure the entire system and oversee operations.
SP_23.scope: The platform covers four sites. The customer site provides menu viewing and online ordering with dish selection and notes, table reservation by time, location and party size supported by an interactive table plan, online payment by multiple methods, real-time order tracking through preparing, ready and completed states, AI recommendations of dishes, combos or restaurants based on preferences and order history and post-meal feedback. The staff site covers order management with real-time receipt, confirmation, updating and fulfilment, reservation handling and real-time notifications for new orders, status changes and customer requests. The restaurant owner site covers menu management including dishes, ingredients, prices and inventory status, employee management with delegation across kitchen, waiting and cashier roles and shift management, a sales and analytics dashboard tracking revenue, profit, bestsellers and order statistics over time, promotion and campaign management, customer insight analysis and feedback tracking. The admin site covers user and restaurant management, role-based access control with granular permissions and sensitive-data protection, system monitoring and platform-wide analytics. Optional advanced scope includes an AI recommendation engine, a 24/7 chatbot, a 3D interactive floor plan, a loyalty and membership system, multi-branch management for restaurant chains and smart forecasting of order demand and raw-material consumption.
SP_23.technology: React, TypeScript, Next.js, ASP.NET Core, SQL Server, Docker, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Vercel, OpenAI API, Gemini API
SP_23.expectedResult: The expected result is a multi-tenant restaurant management platform with database-per-tenant data isolation, delivering the complete customer, staff, owner and administrator experience. Concrete deliverables include online menu browsing, ordering, reservation with an interactive table plan, digital payment and real-time order tracking for customers; real-time order and reservation handling with instant notifications for staff; menu and inventory management with recipe-based deduction, employee and shift management, a sales and analytics dashboard, promotion campaigns, customer insights and feedback tracking for owners; and user, restaurant, permission, monitoring and platform-analytics tooling for administrators. AI-powered recommendations, chatbot support, a 3D interactive floor plan, a loyalty and membership system, multi-branch management and smart demand forecasting are delivered as advanced enhancements, with guaranteed compatibility across multiple platforms and devices.

SP_24.titleEn: Booca - An AI-Integrated Sports Field Booking and Management Platform for Business Venue Owners on Web and Mobile using Next.js, Flutter, Node.js and MongoDB
SP_24.description: Booca is an AI-integrated sports venue booking platform designed to create a comprehensive ecosystem that connects players with sports venues across Vietnam. Unlike traditional booking systems that stop at reserving a court, Booca combines intelligent venue search, AI-powered matchmaking, personalised recommendations, real-time chat and e-commerce in a single connected environment, so that a player can find a venue, form a team, chat with their group, buy equipment and pay without leaving the platform. Venue owners in turn receive a full management toolset for venues, courts, bookings and shop products, and the whole ecosystem operates consistently across a web application and a mobile application sharing the same backend infrastructure.
SP_24.objective: Booca aims to enhance the user experience by providing intelligent venue search, AI-powered recommendations and a seamless booking process; to connect sports players through smart matchmaking that suggests teammates and opponents based on skill level, location and preferences; to empower venue owners with comprehensive management tools for venues, courts, bookings and shop products; to leverage AI technology for personalised recommendations, an intelligent chat assistant and smart matching algorithms; and to ensure a seamless cross-platform experience in which web and mobile applications share the same backend infrastructure.
SP_24.scope: The platform covers four sites across web and mobile. The guest site provides registration, login and password recovery with email verification, access to public information about venues, courts, shops, pricing, reviews and blog posts, browsing and filtering of venues and shops by sport, location, price and rating and detailed venue and shop views with images, reviews and availability calendars. The admin site manages user accounts and permissions, approves, rejects and edits venue registrations, monitors all bookings and resolves disputes, provides dashboards and analytics on revenue, bookings, users and venue statistics, handles system configuration including settings, vouchers, promotions and backups, manages blog, advertisement and review content and approves owner registration requests. The owner site covers venue registration and management with courts, time slots and pricing, booking confirmation and cancellation, dashboard analytics on revenue, booking trends and customer insights, shop and product management and invoice generation. The customer site covers OAuth-supported authentication, venue browsing, search and map-based discovery, booking with payment, matchmaking, an AI chat assistant, personalised recommendations, booking management with invoice download, wishlists, a Booca Coins wallet with top-up and transaction history, reviews and profile management. Advanced scope covers AI matchmaking with team formation and match groups, an AI chat assistant with context-aware venue recommendation, intelligent recommendation of personalised, trending, similar and nearby venues, real-time communication through WebSockets and push notifications, e-commerce with a unified cart, vouchers and multiple payment methods, and social features including a blog, review system and player profiles.
SP_24.technology: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Flutter, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Socket.io, Redis, BullMQ, Google Gemini AI, Firebase Cloud Messaging, Cloudinary, JWT, Passport.js, SendGrid, Nodemailer, Mapbox GL, Leaflet, Puppeteer, GitHub/GitLab, AWS/Azure/Render
SP_24.expectedResult: The expected result is a cross-platform sports booking ecosystem delivered as a Next.js web application and a Flutter mobile application on a shared Node.js and MongoDB backend. It provides a complete booking flow from venue discovery through map-based and filtered search to date, time and court selection with payment, together with a recommendation engine that personalises venue suggestions from booking history, ratings and location, a matchmaking algorithm that pairs teammates and opponents by skill level, location and schedule, and a Gemini-powered chat assistant that answers venue, pricing and booking questions in natural language. Owner-side deliverables include venue, court, booking, shop, product and customer management with analytics dashboards and PDF invoice generation, while administrator deliverables cover approvals, dispute resolution, system configuration, content management and platform-wide analytics. Real-time chat, push notifications, live availability updates, a voucher and wallet payment system and social blog and review features complete the platform.

SP_25.titleEn: DOCIMAL AI - SaaS AI Agent Platform for Embedded Chatbot and Business Workflow Automation using NestJS, FastAPI, Next.js, PostgreSQL, XState, Qdrant and RAG
SP_25.description: In the digital transformation era organisations increasingly want to use AI to optimise operations, customer service and internal knowledge management, but traditional chatbots and standalone LLM solutions run into clear limits: they cannot access or reason over internal data in real time, they do not use company documents effectively, they cannot take actions such as filling forms, sending emails, generating reports or calling internal APIs, and they are difficult to customise to an organisation's workflow, language and communication style. Businesses therefore need a more intelligent conversational platform that combines internal knowledge, real-time data and workflow automation in one integrated system. DOCIMAL is an AI agent platform that understands enterprise knowledge through retrieval-augmented generation, connects to internal and external APIs for personalised real-time data, invokes user-defined tools that turn conversations into actions, embeds securely into existing websites and applications and offers a low-code interface so that non-technical office, customer-service and operations staff can build automation workflows and agents without programming.
SP_25.objective: The project aims to build an AI agent that intelligently chooses between RAG, tools and external APIs according to conversation context; to support document ingestion in PDF, DOCX, XLSX, HTML and TXT formats and provide accurate citation-based answers; to enable users to create and test custom tools directly in a browser-based IDE; to allow integration with external APIs for real-time personalised data; to support organisation management and role-based access control for secure collaboration; to provide an embeddable AI chat widget and SDK for websites and applications; and to offer dashboards for usage, performance and operational insights.
SP_25.scope: The declared in-scope deliverables are a web application providing AI chat, document management, a tool builder, integrations, RBAC and dashboards; backend microservices covering user, agent, conversation, tool, form and integration domains; Python services for RAG document processing and embeddings and for automation templates and workflows; LLM integration through OpenRouter together with local embeddings; a data layer built on PostgreSQL, Qdrant, Redis and MinIO or S3; and Dockerised deployment accompanied by API documentation, technical diagrams and demo workflows. Research scope covers building the full ingestion pipeline from processing through chunking and embeddings to vector search, developing an agent orchestrator that decides when to use tools, RAG or APIs, and ensuring the system is secure, customisable and easy to manage.
SP_25.technology: Next.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui, NestJS, TypeORM, Socket.IO, FastAPI, Python, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis, Qdrant, AWS S3, OpenRouter, LangChain, LlamaIndex, sentence-transformers, Celery, Docker, Kong, Prometheus, Grafana, GitHub Actions, Stripe
SP_25.expectedResult: The expected outputs are a fully functional web application spanning front end, back end, AI services and vector database; an AI agent chat with citations, tool execution and API connectors; a web IDE for creating and testing custom tools; a knowledge-base system with document upload and vector search; an embeddable JavaScript and iframe chat widget for third-party integration; technical documentation covering architecture, ERD, API and deployment; automated tests together with a performance evaluation of accuracy, latency and cost; and demonstration workflows such as an FAQ assistant, a leave request, a quotation generator and operational lookups.

SP_26.titleEn: VTOS - Building a Virtual Try-On Platform for Student Uniform E-Commerce with ASP.NET Core Web API, ReactJS and SQL Server
SP_26.description: Many students and parents struggle when purchasing school uniforms online because they are uncertain about size, fit and overall appearance. These uncertainties lead to incorrect orders, product returns, wasted time and reduced satisfaction, while schools and uniform suppliers lack effective digital tools with which to showcase products, manage catalogues and analyse user needs. This project develops a web-based virtual try-on system that lets students and parents preview uniforms directly on uploaded photos using image processing, segmentation and alignment techniques. The platform not only improves the online shopping experience but also provides schools and vendors with uniform management features, analytics dashboards and an integrated purchasing workflow, delivering an AI-supported system that reduces purchase friction, increases confidence in uniform selection and supports data-driven decisions.
SP_26.objective: The project aims to develop a friendly and intuitive web platform on which students can try on outfits virtually, to apply image-processing techniques that align clothing accurately on an uploaded photograph of a person, and to build a management system covering users, outfits and categories. Beyond these core aims the objective is to deliver a system that reduces purchase friction, increases confidence in uniform selection and supports data-driven decision-making for schools and uniform providers.
SP_26.scope: The system serves three roles. Students register and log in with JWT-based authentication using email or a school-provided account, manage profiles including grade, gender and school affiliation, upload a full-body or portrait photo with automatic quality validation, benefit from AI background segmentation that isolates the body for realistic overlay, browse and search uniforms by school, grade, gender, uniform type, price and size with metadata covering colour variants, size charts and fabric descriptions, view a real-time try-on preview with manual alignment adjustment, receive outfit recommendations based on their profile, track try-on history, download or share watermarked results, submit feedback and ratings, follow shop integration links to affiliated stores and use an AI fit analyser that suggests size based on detected body proportions. Parents create accounts linked to one or more child profiles, manage those profiles, upload child photos, browse and filter uniforms for the child's registered school, preview try-ons per child with separate history tracking, download results, give feedback, purchase through integrated payment gateways such as VNPay or MoMo and track order status including payment confirmation and delivery. Administrators manage student, parent and school accounts with approval and suspension, manage outfit entries with image upload, school assignment and categorisation, maintain a centralised image and file library with version control, enforce security, privacy and access control, optimise performance through caching, CDN and asynchronous loading and generate system reports.
SP_26.technology: ReactJS, ASP.NET Core Web API, C#, .NET 8, Entity Framework, SQL Server, GitHub, Azure DevOps, Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions, AI image segmentation
SP_26.expectedResult: The research applies image-processing and machine-learning techniques to overlay clothing images accurately on a user's uploaded photo while maintaining natural alignment and visual realism. The expected outputs are a fully functional website on which students upload photos and virtually try on uniforms, an admin dashboard for managing users, outfits and categories, a working AI image segmentation module integrated into the try-on feature, and comprehensive documentation covering system design, technical implementation and research results. The platform additionally delivers outfit recommendation, try-on history, result download and sharing, a feedback system, shop and payment integration with order tracking, and an AI fit analyser that recommends sizes from detected body proportions.

SP_27.titleEn: StudySense (SSS) - Building an AI-Based System for Learning Style Analysis and Personalized Self-Study Optimization using .NET, MySQL and Next.js
SP_27.description: StudySense is an AI-assisted personalised self-learning support system designed to analyse students' learning behaviours, learning styles and study performance. Students who study independently rarely have any objective picture of how they actually learn, which subjects they are weak in or how their study habits change over time, so their plans are built on guesswork. By collecting data from learning sessions, surveys and activity logs, StudySense generates personalised study plans, highlights weak subjects and provides actionable daily recommendations that improve learning efficiency. The project combines analytics, recommendation algorithms and cross-platform application development to deliver a complete personalised learning ecosystem spanning web and mobile.
SP_27.objective: The project aims to build a centralised platform that tracks learning habits, study sessions and study performance; to apply AI and analytics to identify learning styles and habits such as visual, auditory and practical orientations; to generate personalised study schedules based on goals, available time and past performance; to provide dashboards, insights and daily recommendations that improve learning efficiency; and to develop a cross-platform system including both web and mobile applications using modern technologies.
SP_27.scope: The system covers learning style and habit analysis that combines behavioural data with survey responses to generate an initial learning profile; study session tracking that records time, activities, interruptions, self-rating and quiz performance; dashboard analytics visualising study time, streaks, learning style, weak subjects and activity heatmaps; AI personalised study planning that generates weekly and monthly plans aligned with goals and available time; daily recommendations providing tasks and reminders based on progress and habit data; optional gamification with XP, streaks and achievement badges; and an admin portal for managing users, surveys, recommendations and system health. Research scope covers learning style analysis and habit modelling from survey and behavioural data, AI-based study plan generation using rule-based scheduling and recommendation logic, and microservice communication and data synchronisation across MySQL, MongoDB and Redis.
SP_27.technology: Next.js, React Native, .NET, Redis, MySQL, MongoDB, Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions, Docker, Vercel
SP_27.expectedResult: The expected outputs are a fully functional web application comprising the StudySense dashboard and study planner, a mobile application built with React Native for tracking study sessions, an AI module producing personalised recommendations and study plans, and an admin portal for managing surveys, users, analytics and configuration. Accompanying deliverables include documentation covering the SRS, design diagrams, deployment guide and test cases, together with source code and a Docker-based deployment environment.

SP_28.titleEn: ThemisOnlineJudge (TMOJ) - Building a Web-Based Online Programming Judge and Evaluation System using NextJS, ASP.NET Core Web API and PostgreSQL
SP_28.description: ThemisOnlineJudge is a web-based programming judge and evaluation system built to support coding exercises, academic assignments and competitive programming contests within a single integrated platform. Students practising programming need instant, objective feedback on their submissions, and lecturers need a way to run classes, assign problem sets and organise contests without grading by hand. TMOJ provides the full workflow from problem creation through submission and judging to analytics, letting students receive automated feedback through secure sandboxed execution and helping lecturers manage classes, contests and evaluation efficiently. Learning paths, leaderboards and performance dashboards are included to increase motivation and engagement.
SP_28.objective: The project aims to build a secure, scalable and high-performance online judge capable of handling multiple concurrent submissions; to develop an automated judging mechanism that compiles and runs code safely within isolated environments; to design a user-friendly interface for both students and lecturers using Next.js and ASP.NET Core Web API; to integrate ranking, analytics and gamification for a more engaging learning experience; and to ensure fairness, reliability and extensibility across both educational and contest use cases.
SP_28.scope: The system covers fourteen functional areas. Submission management lets users submit code in multiple languages, view submission history and compare attempts while lecturers and administrators review, rejudge or delete submissions, with contest time limits enforced and all submissions stored securely. Problem set management lets authorised authors create, edit and publish problems with difficulty, tags, constraints and sample test cases, subject to moderation and approval. Judging management covers uploading and downloading solutions and running test cases through workers that compile and execute code safely and return verdicts such as AC, WA, TLE, MLE and CE. The contest system supports contests with start and end times, problem sets and Codeforces-style scoring, individual or team participation, live scoreboards, freeze periods and remixed virtual contest replays. Further scope covers dashboards and analytics, class and subject management with enrolment and per-class problem assignment, an ELO-style ranking and rating system with per-contest, per-subject and global leaderboards, tagging and searching, profile management with contest history, badges, streaks and linked Google or GitHub accounts, file storage and code archiving with automatic deletion of failed submissions, notifications and announcements, report and export modules producing Excel or CSV summaries, problem discussion and editorial sections with voting and moderation, content moderation and violation reporting, and practice packages and study plans linking sequential problem sets into learning paths.
SP_28.technology: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, ASP.NET Core Web API, PostgreSQL, Docker, Vercel, VPS, Git/GitHub
SP_28.expectedResult: The project delivers a working online programming judge platform implementing the core mechanisms of submission handling, secure sandboxed judging and performance tracking, covering both the front-end interface for users and the back-end services responsible for code compilation, execution and result evaluation. Particular emphasis is placed on problem management, execution handling, contest organisation and data analytics that enhance the overall user experience, so the delivered system provides automated verdict generation, contest hosting with live scoreboards and freeze periods, class management for lecturers, an ELO-based rating and leaderboard system, personal progress dashboards with badges and streaks, editorial and discussion areas with moderation, and Excel or CSV export supporting academic reporting and contest archiving.

SP_29.titleEn: CCTE - Building a Cultural Experience and Craft Village Tourism Ecosystem in Ngu Hanh Son Ward using React, Spring Boot and MySQL
SP_29.description: Ngu Hanh Son Ward holds a strategic position, is rich in cultural heritage and is home to many traditional craft villages, yet the tourism experience there remains disjointed because no modern unified digital platform showcases these strengths. Visitors struggle with scattered, outdated or incomplete information because there is no official hub bringing everything together, and most existing guides are static and non-interactive. Although the ward is surrounded by unique cultural workshops such as marble carving and stone jewellery making, very little information about them reaches tourists, so travellers miss meaningful cultural experiences and local artisans lose opportunities to grow and connect with customers. CCTE addresses this by building a comprehensive digital platform that integrates heritage, interactive experiences, an information portal and commerce into a single user-friendly system spanning web and mobile.
SP_29.objective: The project aims to build a comprehensive digital tourism ecosystem covering heritage, experience and e-commerce through a multi-channel web and mobile platform that connects the heritage values, real-life experiences and commercial transactions of the Ngu Hanh Son area, providing an exploration and information portal for all local attractions, events, workshops and services. It aims to optimise the tourist experience with interactive and immersive technologies including an immersive tour guide with an interactive map, 360-degree viewing points and photo-based check-in, AI guidance through a chatbot for FAQs and itinerary suggestions together with AI-voice narration at points of interest, and smart promotions rewarding tourists with vouchers based on check-ins and workshop attendance. It further aims to establish a collaborative B2B partnership channel through which local business owners submit workshop and event proposals and verify tickets and vouchers by QR code, and to provide an optimal content management system and monitoring framework for administrators and moderators.
SP_29.scope: The web application allows users to search for and explore information about Ngu Hanh Son's tourist attractions and workshops and to preview local scenery through a parallax-style 360-degree viewing feature; enables business owners to register and manage workshop profiles; allows moderators to create and update all information relating to the ward's tourism assets including location details, event information and historical content; provides administrators with a dashboard monitoring overall system status, activity and revenue; and includes a ticket and voucher verification system. The mobile application allows users to find and search information about attractions and workshops, gives access to a tour guide system providing an overall roadmap with check-in spots that motivate users to discover all points of interest, implements photo-based check-in that verifies presence at designated locations and awards rewards, enables AI-voice narration at selected points of interest and provides an AI agent chatbot for frequently asked questions about Ngu Hanh Son.
SP_29.technology: ReactJS, React Native, Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security (JWT), Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, MySQL, Elasticsearch, Pannellum, Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions
SP_29.expectedResult: The research covers implementation of 360-degree virtual tour technology using Pannellum with interactive hotspots, integration of an AI agent chatbot together with text-to-speech for AI-voice narration, development of a B2B portal through which business owners register and manage their own workshops, implementation of full-text search with Elasticsearch for efficient querying of locations and services, and secure authentication and authorisation using Spring Security and JWT across the user, business owner and administrator roles. The expected output is a web application delivering exploration and 360-degree preview, business-owner workshop registration and management, moderator content management, an administrative monitoring dashboard and ticket and voucher verification, together with a mobile application delivering search, a tour-guide roadmap with check-in spots, photo-based check-in with rewards, AI-voice narration and the AI chatbot.

SP_30.titleEn: SLIB - Building a Smart Library Ecosystem with HCE Application, Smart Booking, Reputation Score and AI Analysis using Flutter, PostgreSQL and Spring Boot or FastAPI
SP_30.description: SLIB is a smart library ecosystem designed to modernise how students access and use library spaces. Instead of focusing on traditional book-borrowing workflows, it emphasises smart space management, contactless check-in and check-out, seat booking optimisation and AI-powered assistance. Its core innovation is the integration of Host Card Emulation, which lets students use their smartphones as virtual access cards: tapping the device on entry or exit performs check-in and check-out so the system automatically tracks attendance, usage duration and occupancy analytics. SLIB also introduces an intelligent seat booking system similar to cinema seat reservation, and a reputation score mechanism that encourages responsible seat usage by reducing the score of students who repeatedly book seats without showing up. An AI-assisted chatbot handles common enquiries and reduces librarian workload, while advanced analytics predict busy hours and recommend ideal study times.
SP_30.objective: SLIB aims to transform the library into a smart, data-driven and user-friendly space that improves convenience for students and operational efficiency for librarians. Concretely it aims to implement HCE-based contactless check-in and check-out that automatically records attendance, usage duration and occupancy; to provide an intelligent real-time seat booking system with auto-release rules; to implement a reputation score mechanism that discourages no-shows and can restrict repeat offenders from booking; to reduce librarian workload through an AI chatbot with automatic escalation; and to generate AI-driven analytics that predict busy and quiet hours, recommend ideal study times and produce insights into library usage behaviour.
SP_30.scope: The ecosystem spans a student mobile application, a librarian web portal and an admin web portal, serving four actors. Guests can only view public information such as news and announcements. Students book seats in advance with automatic reputation deduction for no-shows, receive seat-area suggestions based on habits and timetable-aware study-time recommendations, use their smartphone as a virtual library card for HCE-based NFC check-in and check-out, receive check-in reminders, reservation expiry alerts, library news and personalised alerts, view profile, reputation score, check-in history and reservation history with optional gamification metrics such as study streaks and weekly hours, submit feedback that AI classifies by sentiment and topic and routes to the appropriate staff member, and chat with librarians through an AI chatbot that escalates complex queries. Librarians monitor real-time check-in and check-out activity and student presence, manage seat layout across zones and seats, post announcements and news, receive escalated chatbot questions, view reputation scores and generate statistics on hourly usage, peak times and violations. Administrators manage users and roles, seat map configuration and application settings such as check-in windows and reputation rules, run system analytics and reports, maintain the chatbot knowledge base and handle data backup and logging. AI scope covers the FAQ chatbot with auto-escalation, prediction of busy and quiet hours, usage insights for librarians, automatic reputation score calculation and optional anomaly detection for abnormal staying hours or missing check-outs.
SP_30.technology: Flutter, NFC Host Card Emulation, Firebase Cloud Messaging, Spring Boot, FastAPI, Python, RESTful API, PostgreSQL, ReactJS, RAG chatbot, GitHub, Docker, Firebase Hosting, Railway, Render
SP_30.expectedResult: The expected outputs are a functional mobile application for Android and iOS, a real-time seat booking system, an HCE-based check-in and check-out module, an AI-powered chatbot, a web portal for librarians and administrators, an analytics dashboard, and complete documentation covering the SRS, API documentation, system design and test cases. The delivered ecosystem provides students with real-time seat availability, reputation score visibility and AI-predicted best hours to study, gives librarians live occupancy monitoring, seat and zone management, announcement publishing and usage statistics, and gives administrators user and seat-map management, configurable booking and reputation rules, system analytics, chatbot knowledge-base maintenance and data backup and logging.

SP_31.titleEn: FAMS - Academic Management System at FPT University using Spring Boot, ReactJS, Flutter and Python with AI
SP_31.description: FAMS is a comprehensive academic management system for FPT University that centralises and digitises academic and administrative activity currently spread across manual and fragmented processes. Students, lecturers and academic departments each work with separate tools for timetables, attendance, requests and communication, which slows administration and makes reliable oversight impossible. The system replaces this with a unified multi-platform solution covering smart attendance based on AI face recognition combined with Wi-Fi and location verification, automated timetable generation using backtracking with constraint satisfaction, an integrated teaching-and-learning platform with real-time discussion and Q&A, automated academic request handling, real-time analytics dashboards and instant messaging across roles, delivered through both a ReactJS web application and a Flutter mobile application.
SP_31.objective: The project aims to digitise and centralise academic operations by replacing manual and fragmented processes with a unified platform for students, lecturers and academic departments. It implements smart attendance management using AI-based face recognition, Wi-Fi and location-based verification and automatic absence detection; automated scheduling using backtracking combined with constraint satisfaction algorithms to generate optimised timetables that minimise class overlaps, avoid conflicts and reduce gap slots in student schedules; an integrated teaching-learning platform supporting real-time discussion, Q&A and collaborative learning; administrative efficiency through automated academic requests, class schedule change approvals and document management; data analytics and reporting through real-time dashboards covering attendance, academic risk, student performance and graduation progress; communication through instant messaging, notifications and alerts across roles; and multi-platform accessibility on web and mobile.
SP_31.scope: The system serves three roles. Administrators on the web platform handle account management with import, CRUD and lock or unlock operations, lecturer and student management, class, room, department and subject management, semester and slot management, automatic timetable generation with manual adjustment and export, attendance configuration covering Wi-Fi setup and valid check-in times, reports and analytics on attendance and at-risk students, academic request approvals, notification sending and scheduling across the system, roles or classes, and audit-log review with anomaly detection and export. Lecturers on both mobile and web manage teaching classes and schedules, handle attendance including QR code generation, manual check-in and export, submit schedule change requests and track approvals, use the teaching-learning platform for class chat over WebSocket and session notes, and manage assignments with automatic deadlines. Students on both platforms view and export their personal timetable, take attendance via QR code scan or face recognition and review status and history, participate in the teaching-learning platform by posting answers, voting and chatting, and submit assignments. AI and advanced scope covers face recognition with liveness detection to prevent spoofing, predictive analytics identifying at-risk students and a real-time chat system built on WebSocket.
SP_31.technology: ReactJS, Flutter, Java, Spring Boot, Python, FastAPI, Flask, TensorFlow, PyTorch, PostgreSQL, Redis, WebSocket, Git, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, JUnit, Mockito, Postman
SP_31.expectedResult: The research covers AI face recognition using FaceNet or ArcFace embedding models with liveness detection and lighting optimisation, layered architecture separating presentation, application, integration and data concerns, the WebSocket protocol for real-time chat, live attendance updates and push notifications, location verification combining Wi-Fi fingerprinting with GPS geofencing, CI/CD pipelines with blue-green deployment, and an automatic scheduling algorithm using backtracking with constraint satisfaction. Expected outputs are a ReactJS web application for academic services, a Flutter mobile application for attendance, notifications and academic tasks, an AI attendance module combining face recognition with Wi-Fi verification, automated timetable generation that reduces conflicts, a seamless teaching-learning platform with discussion, Q&A and an AI chat box, administrative automation of request approvals and document generation, dashboards with real-time analytics, and system documentation covering architecture design, test reports and deployment guides.

SP_32.titleEn: IERM - Developing an Intelligent Examination Room Management System using NestJS and AI at FPT University
SP_32.description: Facial recognition has become one of the most widely adopted applications of artificial intelligence in authentication and identity verification. In the examination context traditional methods of verifying student attendance, such as manual checking or ID card scanning, are time-consuming, prone to error and vulnerable to impersonation. IERM develops an AI-powered facial recognition system for examination check-in that provides a faster, more secure and more reliable way to verify student identity before entry to the exam room, complemented by an intelligent surveillance module using a rotating or panoramic camera to detect unusual behaviour, and by privacy controls that let students opt in or out of persistent facial-data storage.
SP_32.objective: The project aims to develop an AI-powered facial recognition system for examination check-in that verifies student identity faster, more securely and more reliably than manual checking or ID card scanning. Supporting objectives are to build a mobile check-in application, a TV or large-screen interface for invigilators, and a web dashboard for exam department staff and administrators; to provide an intelligent surveillance module capable of detecting unusual behaviour; to implement a distributed data-management mechanism combining local caching, room-based datasets and hybrid storage; to comply with data protection and privacy requirements through consent flows, encryption and retention policies; and to demonstrate a prototype of a proctor-less examination workflow.
SP_32.scope: The system covers six functional areas. Authentication and roles provide login with role-based access control restricting functions appropriately. User information management covers viewing and updating personal information, managing student information, exam records and facial data with consent options, approving or denying facial data storage for privacy compliance and uploading additional verification documents such as national ID cards. Facial recognition check-in provides real-time face detection and recognition at exam entry, matching against the pre-approved student database, two storage modes covering opt-in persistent storage for faster future check-ins and opt-out temporary storage retained for seven days only, fallback check-in using the invigilator's smartphone, and logging of check-in results with real-time invigilator notification. The exam room dashboard on TV or web provides a real-time list of students in the room, seat map visualisation where available, highlighting of students with check-in issues or identity mismatches and quick actions for invigilators. The exam management module covers creation and management of exam sessions, assignment of rooms, invigilators and student lists and tracking of attendance statistics and incident reports. Security and privacy requirements cover a consent checkbox for facial data usage and end-to-end encryption of sensitive data.
SP_32.technology: Flutter, Next.js, NestJS, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, Docker Compose, Nginx, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Ubuntu VPS
SP_32.expectedResult: Research covers facial recognition models, face embedding and identity verification, optimisation for large-scale facial datasets, the trade-off between edge computing and server-side processing for real-time recognition, anti-spoofing techniques, real-time face detection and tracking, camera calibration and panoramic or rotating camera setups, distributed data processing and caching, secure local, server and hybrid storage, data protection and end-to-end encryption, consent flows, terms of service and retention policy, and deployment through CI/CD pipelines to a VPS with Docker and Nginx. Expected outputs are a fully functional mobile application for facial check-in, a TV or large-screen interface for invigilators, a web dashboard for exam staff and administrators, a real-time facial recognition module, an intelligent surveillance module using a rotating or panoramic camera, a distributed data management mechanism, a working prototype demonstrating a proctor-less examination workflow, and documentation covering system architecture, data flow diagrams, security and privacy compliance, a user manual, testing reports and AI model evaluation.

SP_33.titleEn: PTPP - Building a Personalized Travel Planning Platform using ReactJS, ASP.NET Core API and PostgreSQL
SP_33.description: Planning a trip today means juggling maps, spreadsheets, chat groups and price estimates that never quite add up, and the problem gets worse when several people plan together. PTPP is a personalised travel planning platform that lets users create detailed travel plans covering destinations, schedules, transportation and activities and presents them through an interactive visual timeline or map view. Groups of friends, families or teams can co-plan trips in real time, while artificial intelligence analyses trip details to estimate total costs intelligently and suggests budget optimisations and alternative options that fit the users' preferences. Google Maps and Places integration provides location search and itinerary visualisation, and a premium subscription unlocks the AI features.
SP_33.objective: The project aims to allow users to create detailed travel plans including destinations, schedules, transportation and activities; to present the travel plan through an interactive visual timeline or map view; to enable groups such as friends, families or teams to co-plan trips in real time; to use artificial intelligence to analyse trip details and estimate total costs intelligently; and to suggest budget optimisations and alternative options that fit users' preferences.
SP_33.scope: The platform covers trip planning management with creation, editing and deletion of trip plans including name, duration and destinations; destination and map integration using the Google Places API for search and Google Maps for route display; detailed itinerary notes with estimated time and expenses per destination and marking of locations as completed, skipped or pending; group travel collaboration through travel groups with email or link invitations and collaborative editing of shared plans; real-time group chat; AI-based cost estimation of transportation, accommodation and tickets available to premium users; user account and authentication through email or Google with profile management; payment and subscription through Stripe or PayPal to unlock AI features and extended limits; trip sharing and export of itineraries as PDF documents; and an admin panel for managing users, groups and cached location data and for configuring service packages and pricing. Research scope covers studying how users plan trips in order to design an intuitive workflow, integrating Google Maps and Places APIs, developing the AI cost-estimation module, building group collaboration features and implementing payment and subscription functions.
SP_33.technology: ReactJS, .NET (ASP.NET Core API), PostgreSQL, Google Maps API, Google Places API, Stripe, PayPal, GitHub
SP_33.expectedResult: The expected outputs are a functional web platform for creating, managing and sharing travel plans, an interactive itinerary combining maps with AI-based cost estimation, group planning and chat features, an admin dashboard together with a payment system, and technical documentation including the database design.

SP_34.titleEn: ICPP - Developing a Web Platform to Support Interview Practice and Career Preparation by Industry using NextJS and ASP.NET Core API
SP_34.description: In the current competitive job market many students and job seekers struggle to prepare for interviews and to develop the career skills specific to their chosen field. Existing solutions are fragmented and typically focus on only one aspect, such as CV creation, mentoring or mock interviews, so candidates must assemble their own preparation from several disconnected tools. This project builds a comprehensive web platform that supports interview practice and career preparation across multiple industries including IT, marketing and finance. The system integrates AI technologies that provide real-time feedback, analyse responses and offer career improvement suggestions, and lets users assess their skills through AI analysis, access a library of industry-specific interview questions and receive automated job recommendations based on their performance, so they gain confidence, identify strengths and weaknesses and improve their employability.
SP_34.objective: The project aims to develop a web platform supporting interview practice and career preparation for users across different industries. It allows candidates to choose their desired industry or position for mock interviews, to practise a range of interview formats including multiple-choice, essay, scenario-based and AI voice interviews, to receive instant AI feedback and track performance over time and to upload CVs for AI analysis and optimisation. It enables AI functionality that automatically generates interview questions by field, evaluates responses on vocabulary, logic and communication skills and analyses uploaded CVs to suggest keyword or formatting improvements. It further aims to support administrators in managing industries, premium packages and usage statistics, and to enhance the user experience through data visualisation, progress tracking and personalised career recommendations.
SP_34.scope: The platform covers an intuitive interface through which users select an industry or position, practise interviews and track progress; a comprehensive interview training system supporting multiple-choice, essay, scenario-based and AI voice interview simulations together with peer-contributed questions and a flashcard-based quick review mode; AI feedback and performance analysis that evaluates responses, highlights strengths and weaknesses and provides personalised improvement suggestions after each session; an AI-powered CV module that lets users build or upload CVs, detects grammar and formatting errors and suggests keywords relevant to job descriptions; an admin management dashboard covering users, industries, interview question banks, premium packages, payments and system statistics; and notification and tracking systems that remind users of practice sessions and alert them to new suitable job recommendations. Extended scope includes enterprise access for posting real job openings, connecting with potential candidates and conducting company-style mock interviews, an AI interview bot for automated question generation and real-time interviewing, and comprehensive analytics and reporting covering user performance and platform revenue. Research scope covers user requirement analysis, design of the AI-based mock interview experience, algorithms for job-candidate matching and competency assessment and implementation of intelligent feedback and analytics.
SP_34.technology: Next.js, .NET (ASP.NET Core API), Docker, GitHub, AI/NLP
SP_34.expectedResult: The final outcome is a smart AI-powered interview preparation and career support platform that connects candidates with enterprises and enhances employability across industries. Expected outputs are an intuitive and responsive web platform allowing candidates to select an industry or job position for targeted practice; a multi-format interview training system covering essay and multiple-choice questions, scenario-based and peer-contributed questions, AI-powered voice interview simulations that replicate a real meeting environment and a flashcard quick-review mode; an AI feedback and analytics module that evaluates performance and provides improvement suggestions after each session; a CV creation and analysis module with AI suggestions for grammar correction, layout optimisation and keyword improvement; an administrative dashboard managing question banks by industry, premium subscriptions, payments and platform statistics; and extended modules covering enterprise job posting, an AI interview bot and comprehensive analytics and reporting.

SP_35.titleEn: ISS - Building an Intelligent School Management System using React TS, Tailwind, Spring Boot and PostgreSQL
SP_35.description: In many schools the management of students and academic affairs is still carried out manually or through disconnected standalone tools. This produces persistent difficulties: student status is hard to track, learning results are updated late, and information sharing between teachers, students and parents is limited. The absence of an integrated and centralised management system causes inconsistent data, slow communication and reduced management efficiency, all of which directly affect teaching quality, student monitoring and the overall effectiveness of school management. ISS responds by building a digital platform on which teachers, students, parents and administrators interact, manage and track academic activities in one place, with AI-powered learning analytics and optional facial-recognition attendance layered on top of the core academic modules.
SP_35.objective: The primary objective is to build a digital platform that lets teachers, students, parents and administrators interact, manage and track academic activities more effectively. The system aims to enhance transparency and accuracy in attendance tracking, grade management, class schedule viewing, exam calendar monitoring and school-wide announcements. By digitising and centralising management activities the platform seeks to minimise errors, improve communication, support decision-making and raise the overall quality of the school's educational management, while integrating at least one AI component such as performance prediction, recommendations, a chatbot or facial-recognition attendance.
SP_35.scope: The system covers multi-role user management for administrators, teachers, students and parents with clear role-based access control; student information management covering profiles, contact details, parent and guardian information and uploaded documents such as profile pictures, ID cards, birth certificates and academic records; class and subject management including class creation, homeroom teacher assignment, subject definition per grade level and subject teacher assignment; timetable management with viewing by class, teacher and student; grade and academic result management recording oral quizzes, fifteen-minute tests, forty-five-minute tests, mid-term and final exams with automatic average calculation and categorisation of academic performance and conduct according to regulations; attendance management with manual checks and optional AI-powered facial recognition; a parent and student portal for viewing grades, attendance history, timetables, exam schedules, progress charts and announcements; AI-powered learning analytics comparing individual grade trends with class averages on dashboards; AI-supported risk prediction identifying students at risk of underperformance or retention; optional facial-recognition smart attendance from uploaded class photos with teacher review before finalisation; a notification system; dashboards and analytics for administrators, teachers and students or parents; document upload for policies, study plans, regulations and exam notices; and security with audit logs and PDF or Excel report export.
SP_35.technology: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Git/GitHub, Docker, GitHub Actions, Machine Learning
SP_35.expectedResult: The research covers the practical process and lifecycle of school management including admissions and records, class management, subject and timetable management, grade management, attendance and communication between school, teachers, students and parents; analysis of the roles of administrators, teachers, students and parents and their interaction flows; design of a multi-role management system; and design of AI components for learning analytics including data preprocessing and feature engineering, performance trend analysis, risk prediction, personalised recommendations and optional facial recognition. Expected outputs are a complete web application with core functions covering student management, class and subject management, timetabling, grade and academic result management, attendance tracking, parent and student portals, AI-powered learning analytics, dashboards and reporting; a user-friendly responsive React interface suitable for students, teachers and parents; a secure and scalable Spring Boot REST API back end with role-based access control and a relational schema optimised for school data; and at least one AI component integrated into the system demonstrating a practical application of AI in education.

SP_36.titleEn: HFMD - Website to Diagnose Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease in Young Children through Images and Symptoms using AI, Machine Learning, ASP.NET Core, RESTful API and SQL Server
SP_36.description: Hand, foot and mouth disease is a common viral illness affecting infants and young children, especially in daycare and kindergarten environments. In practice most parents lack medical knowledge and frequently misdiagnose it as an allergy, mosquito bites, viral fever or another skin condition. Many hospitals in Vietnam, particularly paediatric departments, are overloaded, and parents typically bring a child for examination only when symptoms have already worsened, which delays treatment and increases the risk of spreading infection. Parents today photograph their child's rashes or ulcers and search online, but the sources they find are inconsistent, unverified or too general, and no trusted online screening tool exists specifically for early HFMD detection. This project therefore builds a web-based AI screening platform on which parents upload images of skin lesions, report symptoms and receive an initial risk assessment at home, supporting early awareness, reducing unnecessary hospital visits and helping parents decide when to seek professional care.
SP_36.objective: The project aims to build an online HFMD pre-screening tool for parents that combines AI image classification with symptom analysis; to allow parents to create a child profile and store the full diagnosis history; to apply machine-learning and deep-learning models for HFMD classification covering blisters, oral ulcers and rashes; to provide early-warning levels of low, moderate and high risk; and to build administrative tools for managing models, data and users. Medical image datasets for training are collected from publicly available open-access dermatology image datasets, academic publications and HFMD-related medical research repositories including open-licence image collections from research papers and Kaggle open medical image datasets.
SP_36.scope: The system supports two roles. Parents, as the main users, upload images of skin lesions and receive AI-based diagnosis showing detected patterns and recommended next steps saved to the child's diagnosis history; enter symptoms such as fever, rashes and mouth ulcers into a symptom checker built on a hybrid rule-based and AI engine that outputs a mild, moderate or high-risk severity level and merges with the image result for a final assessment; manage child profiles covering age, weight and medical history together with symptom logs, image uploads and full diagnosis history; and export PDF reports for clinic visits or long-term tracking. Administrators manage parents and child profiles, manage datasets and symptom categories, monitor AI model performance including accuracy, precision and recall, handle dataset versioning and automated deployment of updated model versions and view system analytics. Cross-cutting scope covers authentication by email and password, role-based access, encrypted medical data and activity logging, plus an optional credit system in which parents receive free credits that are deducted per image diagnosis, with online payment integration and transaction history.
SP_36.technology: ASP.NET Razor Pages, ASP.NET MVC, ASP.NET Core Web API, RESTful API, SQL Server, AI/Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Git (GitHub/GitLab), GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Docker, AWS, Azure
SP_36.expectedResult: The system helps parents perform initial HFMD screening at home by analysing uploaded lesion images and entered symptoms, with the AI model providing a probability score indicating HFMD likelihood combined with a symptom-based rule engine that improves accuracy. Expected outputs are an AI image classification model for HFMD detection trained on open medical datasets, a symptom checker module dedicated to HFMD, a full website supporting the parent and administrator roles, child medical profile management with a diagnosis history archive, and PDF export of diagnosis records.

SP_37.titleEn: BookLab - Building an Integrated Lab Management System with Scheduling and Usage Tracking for FPT University Da Nang using ASP.NET API, ReactJS and PostgreSQL
SP_37.description: FPT University Da Nang has recently brought its laboratory facilities into operation but has no dedicated system or tool for managing lab scheduling, usage, equipment status or booking approvals. Every related process is handled informally through direct communication, which produces several concrete limitations: room availability is difficult to coordinate without a centralised schedule, there is no mechanism to track actual lab usage or student attendance, equipment conditions and maintenance activities are recorded manually and inconsistently, there is no structured workflow for handling booking or usage requests, and there are no data insights to support planning and resource optimisation. BookLab is an intelligent digital platform that centralises and optimises the complete operational lifecycle of university laboratories, moving beyond simple scheduling to create one integrated ecosystem for faculty, students and administrators.
SP_37.objective: BookLab aims to deliver a streamlined, data-driven environment that enhances operational efficiency and directly supports the institution's academic and research objectives. Its core capability is to link real-time booking data directly with student access control through check-in and check-out, which enables powerful analytics on actual lab utilisation and engagement. Supporting objectives are to centralise lab scheduling and eliminate booking conflicts, to establish a structured approval workflow for lecturer booking requests, to track equipment condition and maintenance systematically, to record student attendance through AI-based FaceID and to generate reporting and analytics that support planning and resource optimisation.
SP_37.scope: The system serves four roles. The academic office imports official semester timetables in Excel or CSV format, allocates labs to courses while preventing scheduling conflicts on a global calendar, reviews, approves or rejects lecturers' booking requests with notes, creates and assigns roles for lecturers, lab managers and students with differing permission levels, and views reports and statistics covering lab utilisation rate, room availability, cancellation rate and equipment condition. Lab managers add, edit and delete equipment information including name, type, quantity and condition across active, broken and under-maintenance states, mark devices or labs as under maintenance so bookings are automatically blocked for that period, view usage data by day, lecturer or device including failure rates, handle booking requests for specialised labs such as IC design and electronics, and receive student feedback while tracking maintenance and repair progress. Lecturers submit booking requests specifying room, date and time, purpose, student count and required equipment, view lab schedules in day, week or month calendar views showing booked, pending and available slots, edit bookings interactively through drag-and-drop before approval, create and manage student groups with member assignment and group schedules, submit post-lab reports describing activities and equipment issues and receive email or in-app notifications about approvals, rejections and reschedules. Students record attendance automatically through AI-based FaceID on entering the lab, view personal and group schedules and submit equipment feedback reporting technical issues or malfunctions.
SP_37.technology: React, TypeScript, HTML5, Tailwind CSS, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, PostgreSQL, Redis, OAuth, JWT, Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure
SP_37.expectedResult: Research covers room scheduling and booking algorithms that ensure real-time updates and minimise conflicts when multiple users book simultaneously, user interface and experience design for the student, instructor and administrator roles, real-time data management for synchronising schedules, availability and confirmations, access control and security including student ID or QR code check-in, reporting and data analytics on lab usage, booking frequency, cancellations and student engagement, and system integration with platforms such as Google Calendar or university management systems. Expected outputs are a functional web-based lab booking system, a room scheduling and conflict management module, a student check-in and check-out attendance tracking system, student performance and lab usage analytics, a booking classification and statistical reporting module, slot and room management with policy control, a role-based access control implementation and comprehensive documentation with research findings.

SP_38.titleEn: FDA - Real-time Flood Monitoring and Safe Route Suggestion System using NextJS, React Native, ASP.NET Core and PostgreSQL
SP_38.description: Vietnam frequently faces heavy rainfall and urban flooding, especially in coastal cities such as Da Nang. During flood seasons residents struggle to obtain real-time information about water levels, which areas are flooded and which routes remain safe to travel, and local authorities have no consolidated picture on which to base a response. This project builds an integrated platform that combines IoT water-level sensors, real-time data visualisation and AI-based route suggestion to enhance public safety and disaster-management efficiency. Water-level readings collected by ESP32-based sensors are streamed into web and mobile applications that display flooded areas with colour gradients, issue alerts for user-defined areas and propose alternative safe routes, while an AI module produces short-term flood forecasts for authorities.
SP_38.objective: The project aims to collect and visualise real-time water-level data from IoT sensors; to provide flood alerts and notifications for specific user-defined areas; to suggest alternative safe routes based on live flood data and map APIs; to support cross-platform accessibility through both web and mobile applications; and to assist local authorities and communities in flood prediction and response.
