SP_38.scope: The system covers a real-time flood map displaying flooded areas with colour gradients representing different water levels; safe route suggestion based on flood data and the Mapbox Directions API; AI-based flood prediction one to three hours ahead; my-areas management allowing users to add, edit or delete the areas they monitor; flood alert notification by push, SMS or email when water levels exceed thresholds; IoT sensor integration collecting water-level data from ESP32-based devices; sensor status monitoring showing online and offline state, battery level and reliability; automatic real-time data update; sensor calibration by administrators; data history and trends with water-level charts by day, week or month; user authentication and profile management using JWT, OAuth or Clerk; role-based access control distinguishing regular users, administrators and authorities; a user dashboard showing monitored areas and recent alerts; bilingual English and Vietnamese support; offline mode on mobile that caches map and alert data; an admin dashboard for managing sensors, users, areas and alert thresholds; flood analytics with statistical charts of flooded regions, frequency and average depth; system logs recording sensor, alert and user activity; export of PDF or CSV reports on flood situations over a selected period; and map layer control across satellite, traffic, hydrology and flood overlays.
SP_38.technology: Next.js, React Native, .NET (ASP.NET Core Web API), PostgreSQL, AWS RDS, Supabase, ESP32 with JSN-SR04T/AJ-SR04M sensors, Mapbox Directions API, Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions, Docker, AWS EC2, Vercel
SP_38.expectedResult: The expected outputs are a Next.js web application for urban residents and local authorities that visualises flood zones and water levels; a React Native mobile application for daily commuters and residents of affected areas providing quick access to alerts and route suggestions; an IoT sensor module built on ESP32 with JSN-SR04T or AJ-SR04M ultrasonic sensors for real-time water-level data collection; an AI module for predictive flood alerting that gives authorities short-term forecasts one to three hours ahead; an admin dashboard for municipal authorities and system operators to manage sensors, set alerts and generate reports; and documentation together with a deployment roadmap for the IT teams that will maintain the system.

SP_39.titleEn: GFMS - Developing a Web Platform for Gym Management with Franchise and Shared Trainer Model using NodeJS and React
SP_39.description: The rapid growth of the fitness industry in Da Nang has increased demand for professional, scalable and efficient gym management systems. Many small and medium gym owners, especially those expanding through franchise models, struggle to standardise operations, manage multiple branches, track revenue and handle personal trainer assignments effectively. At the same time the shared trainer model is emerging as a new trend in which trainers work flexibly across several gyms, helping owners reduce staffing costs and improve service quality; yet most existing management systems do not support this model, making trainer schedules, branch allocation and customer experience difficult to manage. In this context a centralised, intelligent and flexible management platform is essential so that gym owners can operate efficiently, scale franchise networks and maintain consistent service quality.
SP_39.objective: The project aims to build a comprehensive solution for modern gym operations that supports both franchise expansion and shared trainer workflows. The system offers branch management, franchise standardisation, trainer allocation across locations, equipment tracking, member management, multi-branch revenue monitoring and customer care automation. Its purpose is to optimise operational processes, reduce staffing costs, enhance the customer experience and create a sustainable ecosystem for gym owners, trainers and members.
SP_39.scope: Research and functional scope covers six areas. Multi-branch revenue and financial management studies mechanisms for tracking and allocating revenue from membership fees, franchise contributions, rental services and PT sessions across branches and owners, and develops flexible payment management for trainers working across multiple facilities. Customer experience and retention analyses reasons for customer dropout and integrates AI-supported features including a progress tracking system visualising health indicators and individual goals, an AI reminder mechanism for workout schedules, membership renewals and personal goals, and a personalised AI chatbot providing support, training advice and motivation. Shared personal trainer network management implements digital attendance for trainers using NFC or QR codes, a complex schedule mechanism allowing trainers to work across branches on full-time or part-time shifts, processes for handling leave, overtime, shift change and branch transfer requests, and income tracking across facilities. Facility and equipment management digitises daily inventory and status reporting and schedules maintenance with repair history per branch. Branch and franchise management builds a centralised database of franchise locations with dashboards monitoring branch performance and real-time status such as crowd levels, trainer availability and equipment reports. Member and service package management delivers centralised member profiles accessible across the network, flexible multi-branch membership packages and self-service booking, trainer hiring and goal tracking.
SP_39.expectedResult: The expected output is a functional web platform enabling comprehensive management of gyms, trainers and members under a franchise and shared PT model, with a user-friendly interface tailored to each actor. Administrators manage the entire system covering gyms, owners, trainers and members, approve new franchise branch requests and partnership contracts, monitor system-wide statistics on revenue, membership and trainer activity and manage service package catalogues, PT-sharing policies and equipment distribution. Gym owners manage gym information, equipment and service packages, member registration, renewal and workout history, training schedules, PT bookings and participation in shared trainer programmes, and track revenue, expenses and business performance. Personal trainers manage teaching schedules, assigned customer lists and training packages, receive automatic notifications about new schedules, clients and changes and manage profiles, skills, reviews and income. Members register and pay online for training packages, search for and select the nearest gym, book sessions or hire trainers, track workout progress including weight, session count and body metrics and receive personalised notifications, promotions and reminders. Franchise partners submit requests to open new branches and access shared resources. Integrated modules for booking, scheduling, membership management and payment processing, a franchise management module and a reporting and analytics dashboard complete the deliverables.

SP_40.titleEn: SCUDN - Building a Used Car Sales System in Da Nang City using React, NextJS, Java Spring Framework and SQL Server
SP_40.description: In the era of digitalisation and the rapid development of e-commerce, an efficient online management and sales system for the used car market is crucial to staying competitive and driving growth. The automotive industry is evolving not only in scale but also through the integration of advanced technology that meets rising customer demands. Buying a used car today still depends on scattered listings, opaque pricing and manual coordination between buyers and sellers, particularly in the Da Nang market where transactions involve valuation, inspection, negotiation, payment and ownership transfer. This project builds a used car sales system that addresses market needs, optimises business operations and offers customers the best possible experience when purchasing used cars online.
SP_40.objective: The goal of the project is to address the needs of the used car market, to optimise business operations and to offer customers the best possible experience when purchasing used cars online. Concretely it aims to build a platform supporting the standard steps of used car transactions covering valuation, vehicle inspection, negotiation, payment and ownership transfer; to serve the specific characteristics of the Da Nang market including popular models, buyer behaviour and legal regulations; and to meet the needs of both buyers and sellers for easy search, advertisement management, appointment scheduling and secure transactions.
SP_40.scope: The system covers user management with registration, login, profile management and the buyer, seller and administrator roles; car listings that sellers create, update and delete with details such as make, model, price and images and that administrators approve; advanced search and filtering by criteria including price, model and location together with sorting options; a car details page presenting detailed information, images, a contact-seller option and vehicle history; communication through in-app messaging, notifications and test drive scheduling; transactions covering price negotiation, secure payment processing and invoice generation; an admin panel providing user and listing management, analytics and content moderation; reviews and ratings for sellers and listings with administrator moderation; and SEO and marketing features covering SEO-optimised pages, social sharing and email marketing. Research scope covers the used car sales process, Da Nang market characteristics and user requirements, while engineering scope covers requirement analysis, front-end development with React and Next.js for a user-friendly SEO-optimised interface, back-end development with Java Spring Framework for business logic, security and APIs, SQL Server data management and UI/UX design.
SP_40.technology: ReactJS, Next.js, Java, Spring Framework, SQL Server, Jenkins
SP_40.expectedResult: The expected outcome is a used car sales system that meets the needs of the Da Nang market, is user-friendly and secure and can be expanded as needed. The delivered platform provides user management with role separation, seller listing management with administrator approval, advanced search, filtering and sorting, detailed car pages including vehicle history, in-app messaging with notifications and test drive scheduling, price negotiation with secure payment processing and invoice generation, an administrative panel with analytics and content moderation, a reviews and ratings system with moderation, and SEO-optimised pages with social sharing and email marketing. A specific security requirement is that all queries made to SQL must be escaped so that SQL injection is not possible.
